teaser.sw: Ukiendesha gari kwenye barabara ya pwani ya kusini msimu ukifika, utaona marundo ya machungwa yenye maganda ya kijani yakiuzwa kando ya barabara.
teaser.dg: Uchiphiya na gari kpwenye njira ya pwani ya kusini wakati wa machungbwa, undaona vifungu vya machungbwa ga chijani ganaguzwa kanda-kanda ya njira.

teaser.en: Too bitter and sour to eat fresh, the Seville orange earns its place in the kitchen and in home medicine.
teaser.sw: Ni mchungu na mchachu mno kuliwa bichi, lakini mdanzi umejipatia nafasi jikoni na katika dawa za nyumbani.
teaser.dg: Matundage ni ga utsungu na ngbwadu sana hata tagariwa dza garivyo, ela *mdandzi* una nafasiye dzikoni na kpwenye dawa za kaya.

teaser.en: No *samaki wa kupaka* is complete without a squeeze of lime, the small green fruit of the homestead *mdimu*.
teaser.sw: Hakuna *samaki wa kupaka* kamili bila kukamuliwa ndimu, tunda dogo la kijani la *mdimu* wa nyumbani.
teaser.dg: *Samaki wa kupaka* tauna ladha kamili bila kuminyirwa ndimu, tunda dide ra chijani ra *mdimu* wa mudzini.

teaser.en: A single jackfruit can outweigh a small child, and it grows straight out of the trunk rather than from the branches.
teaser.sw: Fenesi moja linaweza kuwa zito kuliko mtoto mdogo, na huota moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye shina badala ya matawi.
teaser.dg: Fenesi rimwenga rinaweza kukala rizito kuriko mwana mdide, na rinamera kula kpwa kolo moja kpwa moja, si kula kpwa panda.

teaser.en: Found only on the coasts of Kenya and Tanzania, this wild tree drops good fruit for anyone who knows where to look.
teaser.sw: Unapatikana tu katika pwani za Kenya na Tanzania, mti huu wa porini huangusha matunda mazuri kwa yeyote anayejua mahali pa kutafuta.
teaser.dg: Unaphahikana pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania tu; matunda manono ga muhi hinyu wa tsaka ganagbwa photsi kpwa yeyesi anayemanya phatu pha kugahendza.

teaser.en: Digo farmers grow some twenty-five kinds of banana, with names like 'elephant's hand' and 'arrow'.
teaser.sw: Wakulima Wadigo hupanda takriban aina ishirini na tano za ndizi, zenye majina kama 'mkono wa tembo' na 'mshale'.
teaser.dg: Akurima a Chidigo anarima aina phephi ishirini na tsano za ndizi, zenye madzina dza 'mkpwono wa ndzovu' na 'mshale'.

teaser.en: The sticky brown pulp of the tamarind pod sours porridge, fish sauce and cold drinks right across the coast.
teaser.sw: Unga wa kahawia unaonata wa kaka la ukwaju huongeza uchachu kwenye uji, mchuzi wa samaki na vinywaji baridi kote pwani.
teaser.dg: Unga wa rangi ya dongo unaonyata wa kpwadzu unahenda uji, mtsuzi wa ng'onda na vinwadzi vya mnyevu vikale vya ngbwadu kosi pwani.

teaser.en: Digo has two words for the lemon, *limau* and *kapu*, and both are understood by Digo speakers everywhere.
teaser.sw: Kidigo kina maneno mawili ya limau, *limau* na *kapu*, na yote mawili yanaeleweka na wazungumzaji wa Kidigo kila mahali.
teaser.dg: Chidigo china maneno mairi ga limau, *limau* na *kapu*, na gosi mairi ganamanyikana ni atu osi anaogomba Chidigo kosi.

teaser.en: Its trunk bristles with long thorns, which is why farmers plant it as a living fence that also bears sweet fruit.
teaser.sw: Shina lake limejaa miiba mirefu, na ndiyo sababu wakulima huupanda kama uzio hai unaozaa pia matunda matamu.
teaser.dg: Kolore rinadzala miya mire, na ndiyo mana akurima nkuuphanda dza lichigo ra mihi inayomera, ririrolavya piya matunda ga mtswano.

teaser.en: The Digo call one red-fleshed pawpaw *moyo wa simba*, 'lion's heart'.
teaser.sw: Wadigo huita aina moja ya papai lenye nyama nyekundu *moyo wa simba*.
teaser.dg: Adigo nkuiha aina mwenga ya papali yenye nyama ya kundu *moyo wa simba*.

teaser.en: Its smooth trunk peels like old paint, revealing patches of copper and green beneath.
teaser.sw: Shina lake laini humenyuka kama rangi kuukuu, likifichua mabaka ya rangi ya shaba na kijani chini yake.
teaser.dg: Gopha ra kolore laini rinatuluka vipande-vipande dza rangi ya kare, na kuonyesa mabaka ga rangi ya shaba na ya chijani photsize.

teaser.en: The Digo word for rubber, *mpira*, comes from this forest vine, which was once tapped for its sticky white latex.
teaser.sw: Neno la Kidigo la mpira, *mpira*, linatokana na mtambaa huu wa msituni, ambao zamani uligemwa kwa utomvu wake mweupe unaonata.
teaser.dg: Neno *mpira*, ambaro kpwa Chidigo rina mana ya *rubber*, rinalavywa kula mmea hinyu wa tsaka unaokpwera, ambao kare kala unatuluzwa maziyage mereru ganayonyata.

teaser.en: The ribs of wooden dhows have been cut from this thorny little fruit tree.
teaser.sw: Mbavu za majahazi ya mbao zimekuwa zikichongwa kutoka kwa mti huu mdogo wa matunda wenye miiba.
teaser.dg: Mbavu za majahazi ga mbao zikakatwa kula muhi hinyu mdide wa matunda wenye miya.

teaser.en: This giant forest vine climbs to the treetops and drops big orange fruits whose tangy pulp is sucked straight off the seeds.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa huu mkubwa wa msituni hupanda hadi vilele vya miti na kuangusha matunda makubwa ya rangi ya chungwa ambayo nyama yake chachu hufyonzwa moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye mbegu.
teaser.dg: Mmea hinyu mkulu wa tsaka unaokpwera unafika dzulu kabisa ya mihi, na matundage makulu ga rangi ya chungbwa ganagbwa photsi; atu nkufyondza nyama ya ngbwadu ya matunda higo kula kpwenye tembe.

teaser.en: Healers call the baobab 'the great one who is never betrayed', because as a medicine it is said never to fail.
teaser.sw: Waganga huuita mbuyu 'mkubwa asiyesalitiwa', kwa sababu kama dawa inasemekana haushindwi kamwe.
teaser.dg: Aganga anauiha muuyu 'mkulu kazingwa', mkulu ambaye kasalatwa, kpwa sababu nkugombwa kukala dza dawa taushindwa kabisa.

teaser.en: Digo farmers name at least eighteen kinds of mango, from *dodo* and *ngoe* to *shikio punda*, 'donkey's ear'.
teaser.sw: Wakulima Wadigo hutaja angalau aina kumi na nane za maembe, kuanzia *dodo* na *ngoe* hadi *shikio punda*, 'sikio la punda'.
teaser.dg: Akurima a Chidigo anataja aina za embe zisizophungukira kumi na nane, kula *dodo* na *ngoe* hadi *shikio punda*, 'sikiro ra punda'.

teaser.en: Eat a handful of these dark berries and your tongue turns purple for the rest of the afternoon.
teaser.sw: Ukila konzi moja ya matunda haya meusi, ulimi wako hubaki wa zambarau mchana wote.
teaser.dg: Uchirya matunda gaga maru mkpwono mmwenga, lilimiro rindagaluka rangi ya zambarau hadi dziloni.

teaser.en: Each pineapple plant puts all its effort into a single fruit, perched on top of a rosette of spiny leaves.
teaser.sw: Kila mmea wa nanasi huweka nguvu zake zote katika tunda moja, lililokaa juu ya shada la majani yenye miiba.
teaser.dg: Chila mmea wa nanasi unaika nguvuze zosi kpwenye tunda mwenga, ambaro ri dzulu ya makodza genye miya ganayozunguluka phamwenga.

teaser.en: Digo simply borrowed the name of this newcomer fruit: the avocado is *ovakado*.
teaser.sw: Kidigo kiliazima tu jina la tunda hili lililofika karibuni: parachichi ni *ovakado*.
teaser.dg: Tunda hiri ni mjeni pwani, na Chidigo chahala tu dzinare: *avocado* ni *ovakado*.

teaser.en: Under its spiny green skin, the soursop hides soft white pulp that tastes like pineapple and strawberry with a sour twist.
teaser.sw: Chini ya ganda lake la kijani lenye miiba, mstafeli huficha nyama laini nyeupe yenye ladha ya nanasi na stroberi pamoja na uchachu kidogo.
teaser.dg: Ndani ya gadare ra chijani renye miya, *soursop* unafwitsa nyama nyereru laini, yenye ladha dza nanasi na *strawberry* na ngbwadu chidide.

teaser.en: Digo has two names for the watermelon, and one of them, *renje-madzi*, seems to carry the word for water inside it.
teaser.sw: Kidigo kina majina mawili ya tikiti, na moja wapo, *renje-madzi*, linaonekana kubeba ndani yake neno la maji.
teaser.dg: Chidigo china madzina mairi ga *tigiti*, na rimwenga kahi yao, *renje-madzi*, rinaonekana kukala na neno *madzi* ndani.

teaser.en: Slice a green okra pod and it turns silky in the pot, thickening coconut stews the way cooks on the coast like.
teaser.sw: Katakata ganda bichi la bamia na huwa laini kama hariri chunguni, likiufanya mchuzi wa nazi kuwa mzito kama wapendavyo wapishi wa pwani.
teaser.dg: Checha benda ra chijani, na nyunguni rinakala laini na ra luhe, rinahenda mtsuzi wa huwi ukale mzito dza vira ajiti a pwani anavyomendza.

teaser.en: Digo gardeners call the big hybrid eggplant *bungulia ra chizungu*, setting it apart from the older local kinds.
teaser.sw: Wakulima wa Kidigo huita biringani kubwa ya mbegu chotara *bungulia ra chizungu*, ili kuitofautisha na aina za zamani za kienyeji.
teaser.dg: Adigo anaorima busitani nkuiha bungulia kulu ra *hybrid* *bungulia ra chizungu*, kuritafwautisha na aina za chienyeji za kare.

teaser.en: Nobody needs to plant this amaranth: it simply turns up in the farm, and ends up in the pot with coconut milk.
teaser.sw: Hakuna haja ya kupanda mchicha huu: huota wenyewe shambani, na mwishowe huishia chunguni na tui la nazi.
teaser.dg: Takuna mutu anayehitaji kuchiphanda *chiswenya*: chinazuka tu mundani, chisha chinaphiya nyunguni phamwenga na huwi.

teaser.en: Pumpkins on the coast often sprout from rubbish heaps, where a few thrown-out seeds turn into a sprawling vine.
teaser.sw: Pwani, maboga mara nyingi huota kwenye majaa, ambapo mbegu chache zilizotupwa hugeuka kuwa mtambaa unaoenea kila upande.
teaser.dg: Pwani, mara nyinji madzungu ganamera madzalani, phatu tembe chache zirizotsuphwa zinakala mmea mure unaoambala na kuenea.

teaser.en: This creeping weed with pale bell-shaped flowers has three Digo names, and its leaves go into the cooking pot.
teaser.sw: Gugu hili linalotambaa, lenye maua mepesi ya umbo la kengele, lina majina matatu ya Kidigo, na majani yake huingia chunguni.
teaser.dg: Mbondo hino inayoambala, yenye maruwa ga ngushu-ngushu ga umbo ra kengele, ina madzina mahahu ga Chidigo, na makodzage ganaphiya nyunguni.

teaser.en: When palm-wine tappers climb down a coconut palm, the gourd hanging at their side once grew on this vine.
teaser.sw: Wagemaji wa tembo wanaposhuka kutoka kwenye mnazi, kibuyu kinachoning'inia ubavuni mwao kiliwahi kuota kwenye mtambaa huu.
teaser.dg: Ajema achitserera kula dzulu ya mnazi, buru rinarogbwadzika kanda-kanda yao kala rinamera kpwenye mmea huno.

teaser.en: Swahili speakers everywhere know *mchicha*, but this tall amaranth goes by the same name in Digo gardens.
teaser.sw: Wazungumzaji wa Kiswahili kila mahali wanaujua *mchicha*, na mchicha huu mrefu huitwa kwa jina hilo hilo katika bustani za Kidigo.
teaser.dg: Atu anaogomba Chiswahili chila phatu anamanya *mchicha*, ela *mchicha* huno mrefu piya unaihwa vivyo busitani za Adigo.

teaser.en: Cooks pick *mnavu* by the look and the taste of its leaves, which carry a gentle bitterness that coconut milk softens.
teaser.sw: Wapishi huchagua *mnavu* kwa kuangalia sura na ladha ya majani yake, ambayo yana uchungu kidogo unaolainishwa na tui la nazi.
teaser.dg: Ajiti nkutsambula *mnavu* kpwa kulola sura na ladha ya makodzage, ambago gana utsungu chidide unaophunguzwa ni huwi.

teaser.en: Crushed moringa seeds can clear muddy water, and the same tree gives leaves and long drumstick pods for the pot.
teaser.sw: Mbegu za mronge zilizopondwa zinaweza kusafisha maji ya matope, na mti huo huo hutoa majani na maganda marefu kama vijiti vya ngoma kwa ajili ya chungu.
teaser.dg: Tembe za *moringa* zichitwangbwa zinaweza kueza madzi ga matope, na muhi uho uho unapha makodza na makakaya mare dza fwimbo za kupigira ngoma, kpwa nyungu.

english: Jute mallow, Jew's mallow, bush okra

teaser.en: These leaves turn slippery in the pot, and that is exactly what makes them a well-loved relish with ugali.
teaser.sw: Majani haya huteleza yanapopikwa chunguni, na hilo ndilo hasa linalofanya yawe mboga inayopendwa sana ya kulia ugali.
teaser.dg: Makodza higa ganakala ga luhe nyunguni, na ndiyo sababu ni mboga inayomendzwa sana, inayoriwa na sima.

teaser.en: A wild cousin of sesame that grows on resting farmland, its leaves cook into a slippery green relish.
teaser.sw: Jamaa wa porini wa ufuta anayeota kwenye mashamba yaliyoachwa yapumzike; majani yake hupikwa kuwa mboga ya kijani inayoteleza.
teaser.dg: *Mrenda* ni nduguye wa tsaka wa ufuha, unaomera kpwenye minda iriyorichwa ioye, na makodzage gachijitwa ganakala mboga ya chijani ya luhe.

teaser.en: Raw *mriga* tubers are poisonous, and a look-alike vine is never eaten at all, so knowing this yam is real knowledge.
teaser.sw: Viazi vibichi vya *mriga* vina sumu, na mtambaa unaofanana nao hauliwi kabisa, kwa hiyo kuujua mmea huu wa kiazi kikuu ni elimu ya kweli.
teaser.dg: Viazi vya *mriga* vichikala viitsi vina sumu, na mmea unaohalana nao taurika kabisa, kpwa hivyo kuumanya *mriga* ni marifwa ga kpweli.

teaser.en: Its Digo name means simply 'bitter vegetable', and that bitterness is part of why it ends up both in the pot and in medicine.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo lina maana tu ya 'mboga chungu', na uchungu huo ni sehemu ya sababu ya kuishia chunguni na pia kwenye dawa.
teaser.dg: Dzinare ra Chidigo rina mana ya 'mboga ya utsungu' tu, na utsungu uho ni seemu ya sababu unaphiya nyunguni na piya kpwenye dawa.

teaser.en: Long before the big market tomato, Digo gardens had their own small 'bush tomato', called *tindi*.
teaser.sw: Muda mrefu kabla ya nyanya kubwa za sokoni, bustani za Kidigo zilikuwa na 'nyanya ya porini' yao ndogo, iitwayo *tindi*.
teaser.dg: Kare sana, kabla ya nyanya kulu za sokoni, busitani za Adigo kala zina nyanya yao ndide ya chienyeji, inayoihwa *tindi*.

teaser.en: The garden *tungudza* has a wild cousin, *mtungudza koma*, that is used in medicine instead of the cooking pot.
teaser.sw: *Tungudza* wa bustanini ana jamaa wa porini, *mtungudza koma*, ambaye hutumika kama dawa badala ya kuingia chunguni.
teaser.dg: *Tungudza* ra busitanini rina nduguye wa tsaka, *mtungudza koma*, unaohumirwa kpwa dawa badala ya kuphiya nyunguni.

teaser.en: The warm scent of a coast kitchen at breakfast, when *mahamri* are frying, comes largely from cardamom.
teaser.sw: Harufu tamu na ya joto ya jikoni pwani wakati wa kifungua kinywa, mahamri yanapokaangwa, kwa kiasi kikubwa hutokana na iliki.
teaser.dg: Arufu nono ya dzoho ya dzikoni pwani wakati wa chai ya ligundzu, *mahamri* gachikalangwa, inalavywa zaidi ni *cardamom*.

teaser.en: In Digo, the word for turmeric, *mandano*, is also the word for the colour yellow.
teaser.sw: Kwa Kidigo, neno la manjano (kiungo), *mandano*, ndilo pia neno la rangi ya manjano.
teaser.dg: Kpwa Chidigo, *mandano* ni chikatsu, na piya ni neno ra rangi: *rangi ya mandano*, ambayo kpwa Chingereza ni *yellow*.

teaser.en: Its Digo name comes from *ruhani*, a spirit, and healers use this clove-scented basil against illnesses blamed on it.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo linatokana na *ruhani*, pepo, na waganga hutumia mrihani huu wenye harufu ya karafuu dhidi ya magonjwa yanayohusishwa na pepo huyo.
teaser.dg: Dzinare ra Chidigo rinalavywa kula *ruhani*, pepho, na aganga nkuhumira *chirahani* hichi, chenye arufu ya karafuu, kuphoza makongo ganayoaminika kurehwa ni pepho iyo.

teaser.en: Almost every Digo pot starts the same way: with *chitunguu madzi* sizzling at the bottom.
teaser.sw: Karibu kila chungu cha Kidigo huanza kwa njia ileile: *chitunguu madzi* kikichacharika chini yake.
teaser.dg: Karibu chila nyungu ya Adigo inaandza vivyo hivyo: *chitunguu madzi* chichikalangwa photsi.

teaser.en: Garlic is bought, not grown, on the south coast, but it earns its place both in the cooking and in home medicine.
teaser.sw: Pwani ya kusini kitunguu saumu hununuliwa, hakipandwi, lakini kina nafasi yake jikoni na pia katika tiba za nyumbani.
teaser.dg: Pwani ya kusini *chitunguu saumu* nkugulwa, si kurimwa, ela china nafwasiye kpwenye kujita vyakurya na kpwenye dawa za kaya.

teaser.en: In Diani, the most common Digo way to keep mosquitoes off is to burn the leaves of this fragrant bush.
teaser.sw: Huko Diani, njia ya kawaida zaidi kwa Wadigo kufukuza mbu ni kuchoma majani ya kichaka hiki chenye harufu nzuri.
teaser.dg: Kuko Diani, njira ya Adigo ya kawaida zaidi ya kuzuwiya imbu ni kufukiza makodza ga chitsaka hichi chenye arufu nono.

teaser.en: The sweet warmth in a coastal pilau or biriani often comes from curls of bark peeled from a tree that grows far away.
teaser.sw: Ladha tamu ya joto katika pilau au biriani ya pwani mara nyingi hutoka kwenye maganda yaliyojikunja ya gome la mti unaoota mbali sana.
teaser.dg: Dzoho-dzoho ya mtswano kpwenye *pilau* au *biriani* ya pwani mara nyinji inalavywa ni vipande vya gopha vinavyodzikundza, vinavyouswa kula muhi unaomera kure.

teaser.en: Each clove is a flower bud picked before it could open, dried and shipped from the islands of Zanzibar and Pemba.
teaser.sw: Kila karafuu ni kichipukizi cha ua kilichochumwa kabla hakijachanua, kikakaushwa na kusafirishwa kutoka visiwa vya Zanzibar na Pemba.
teaser.dg: Chila karafuu ni chimea cha ruwa chirichohundwa kabla ya kuvuguka, chikaanikpwa na kurehwa kpwa meli kula visiwa vya Zanzibar na Pemba.

teaser.en: Digo gardeners name at least six kinds of chilli, from the tiny, fiery *mwatsaka wa chitsawetsawe* to *mwatsaka wa masala*.
teaser.sw: Wakulima wa bustani wa Kidigo hutaja angalau aina sita za pilipili, kuanzia *mwatsaka wa chitsawetsawe*, ndogo na kali mno, hadi *mwatsaka wa masala*.
teaser.dg: Akurima a busitani a Chidigo anamanya aina sita za mwatsaka au zaidi, kula *mwatsaka wa chitsawetsawe* mdide na mkali sana, hadi *mwatsaka wa masala*.

teaser.en: Brush past a clump of *mzumaa* by the house and the air fills with the clean scent of lemons.
teaser.sw: Ukipita karibu na kichaka cha *mzumaa* kando ya nyumba, hewa hujaa harufu safi ya malimau.
teaser.dg: Uchitsupa phephi na fungu ra *mzumaa* kanda-kanda ya nyumba, hewa inaodzala arufu safi ya malimau.

teaser.en: Coffee with ginger after an operation: on the coast this spicy root is trusted to help people back on their feet.
teaser.sw: Kahawa yenye tangawizi baada ya upasuaji: pwani, mzizi huu wenye ukali huaminiwa kumsaidia mtu kurudia hali yake.
teaser.dg: Kahawa na tangawizi bada ya kupasuliwa: pwani, muzi huno mkali nkuluphirwa kuterya atu apone.

teaser.en: Before a wedding or at Eid, hands and feet across the coast are painted orange-red with the crushed leaves of this shrub.
teaser.sw: Kabla ya harusi au wakati wa Idi, mikono na miguu kote pwani hupakwa rangi nyekundu ya chungwa kwa majani yaliyopondwa ya kichaka hiki.
teaser.dg: Kabla ya arusi au wakati wa Idi, mikono na magulu kosi pwani nkupakpwa rangi ya chungbwa na kundu kpwa makodza ga chitsaka hichi ganayosirwa.

teaser.en: On the coast, coffee comes strong, black and in tiny cups, often with a kick of ginger.
teaser.sw: Pwani, kahawa huja kali, nyeusi na katika vikombe vidogo, mara nyingi ikiwa na ukali wa tangawizi.
teaser.dg: Pwani, kahawa nkunwewa ndziho na nyiru, kpwa vikombe vidide sana, na mara nyinji ina ukali wa tangawizi.

teaser.en: When its pods split, this tall tree releases clouds of silky fluff, which was used to stuff mattresses and pillows.
teaser.sw: Maganda yake yanapopasuka, mti huu mrefu hutoa mawingu ya pamba laini kama hariri, iliyotumika kujaza magodoro na mito.
teaser.dg: Makakayage gachiahuka, muhi hinyu mure unatuluza sufi nyinji laini dza maingu, iriyokala ichihumirwa kuodzaza magodoro na mito.

teaser.en: Its name comes from the Swahili word for forty, after the forty diseases this bitter tree is said to cure.
teaser.sw: Jina lake linatokana na neno la Kiswahili la arobaini, kwa sababu ya magonjwa arobaini ambayo mti huu mchungu husemekana kuyatibu.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rinalavywa kula neno ra Chiswahili ra 'arubaini', kpwa sababu ya makongo arubaini ambago nkugombwa muhi uhu wa utsungu unagaphoza.

teaser.en: Castor oil is among the offerings a man must bring to become an elder of Kaya Kinondo.
teaser.sw: Mafuta ya mbono ni miongoni mwa matoleo ambayo mwanamume lazima alete ili kuwa mzee wa Kaya Kinondo.
teaser.dg: Mafuha ga *mwono* ni kahi ya sadaka ambazo mlume ni lazima arehe ili akale mzehe wa Kaya Kinondo.

teaser.en: A Digo proverb holds that *chiko chaajira ndilo*: a pipe suits an honourable person.
teaser.sw: Methali ya Kidigo inasema *chiko chaajira ndilo*: kiko humfaa mtu mwenye heshima.
teaser.dg: Ndarira ya Chidigo inagomba *chiko chaajira ndilo*: chiko chinamfwaha mutu wa hishima.

teaser.en: A thin, hairy creeper above ground, and below it a buried tuber that can grow as heavy as a sack of maize.
teaser.sw: Juu ya ardhi ni mtambaa mwembamba wenye vinyweleo, na chini yake kiazi kilichozikwa kinachoweza kufikia uzito wa gunia la mahindi.
teaser.dg: Dzulu ya tsi kuna mmea mwembamba unaokpwera, wenye nyere, na tsini ya tsi kuna chiazi chikulu chinachoweza kukala chizito dza gunia ra pemba.

teaser.en: A small orchid perched on a branch like a hen brooding on her eggs, which is exactly what its Digo name says.
teaser.sw: Okidi mdogo aliyekaa juu ya tawi kama kuku anayeatamia mayai yake, na hivyo ndivyo hasa jina lake la Kidigo linavyosema.
teaser.dg: *Orchid* ndide iriyosagala dzulu ya panda dza kuku asagalaye dzulu ya matumbige; ndivyo dzinare ra Chidigo rinavyogomba.

teaser.en: Africa's leopard orchid: big clumps of cane-like stems high in a tree, and sprays of yellow flowers spotted brown.
teaser.sw: Okidi chui wa Afrika: makundi makubwa ya mashina kama miwa juu ya mti, na mashada ya maua ya manjano yenye madoa ya kahawia.
teaser.dg: *Chiahira* hino ni *leopard orchid* ya Afrika: mafungu makulu ga mihi dza miwa dzulu ya muhi, na milita mire ya maruwa ga rangi ya mandano genye mabara ga rangi ya dongo.

teaser.en: A wild pigeon pea that nobody planted: Digo call it God's pigeon pea, or the pigeon pea from outside.
teaser.sw: Mbaazi pori ambayo hakuna aliyeipanda: Wadigo huiita mbaazi ya Mungu, au mbaazi ya nje.
teaser.dg: Mbalazi ya weruni ambayo takuna ariyeiphanda: Adigo anaiiha mbalazi ya Mlungu, au mbalazi ya kondze.

teaser.en: A slender, unassuming herb that Digo tell apart by its leaves and its small fruit capsules.
teaser.sw: Mmea mwembamba usio na makuu, ambao Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake na vibuyu vyake vidogo vya matunda.
teaser.dg: Mmea mdide mwembamba usio na makuu, ambao Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage na makakaya madide ga matundage.

teaser.en: Snap a leaf and white milk runs out; look up and you may see its warty green fruits hanging in pairs.
teaser.sw: Vunja jani na maziwa meupe hutiririka; tazama juu na huenda ukaona matunda yake ya kijani yenye vigwaru yakining'inia wawili wawili.
teaser.dg: Gbwanyula kodza na maziya mereru ganatuluka; lola dzulu na unaweza kuona matundage ga chijani genye maugu ganalengela mairi mairi.

teaser.en: Its name simply means 'little climber', and Digo think of it as the female half of a pair.
teaser.sw: Jina lake lina maana tu ya 'mtambaa mdogo', na Wadigo humwona kama nusu ya kike ya jozi.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rina mana ya 'mbugu dide' tu, na Adigo anachiona dza nusu ya chichetu ya jozi.

teaser.en: The 'male climber', though it doesn't really climb, and nobody could say why it counts as male.
teaser.sw: 'Mtambaaji dume', ingawa kwa kweli hautambai, na hakuna aliyeweza kueleza kwa nini unahesabiwa kuwa dume.
teaser.dg: 'Mbugu ya chilume', hata kala taikpwera kpwa kpweli, na takuna ariyeweza kugomba kpwa nini inaonwa kukala ni ya chilume.

teaser.en: A climber that seems to grow out of nowhere: Digo named it the plant with no stem base, and they were right.
teaser.sw: Mtambaaji unaoonekana kuota bila chanzo: Wadigo waliuita mmea usio na kitako cha shina, na walikuwa sahihi.
teaser.dg: Mbugu inayoonekana kumera bila kula phatu phosi: Adigo anaiiha mmea usio na kolo, na ni kpweli.

teaser.en: 'Water gourd' — a name that may hint at an old use for its pods, though no one has confirmed it.
teaser.sw: 'Kibuyu cha maji': jina ambalo huenda linadokeza matumizi ya zamani ya maganda yake, ingawa hakuna aliyethibitisha.
teaser.dg: 'Chiburu cha madzi': dzina ambaro rinaweza kuonyesa vira makakayage gakala ganahumirwa kare, ela takuna ariyehakikisha.

teaser.en: Crush a leaf and it smells of citrus: Digo call it the little wild lime of the forest.
teaser.sw: Ponda jani lake na litanukia kama limau: Wadigo huuita mdimu mdogo wa porini wa msituni.
teaser.dg: Hopeza kodza na rinalavya arufu dza ya ndimu: Adigo anachiiha mdimu mdide wa tsakani.

teaser.en: Its name means 'piercing', and anyone who brushes against it barefoot learns why.
teaser.sw: Jina lake maana yake ni 'kuchoma', na yeyote anayekigusa bila viatu hujua kwa nini.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rina mana ya 'kudunga-dunga', na yeyesi anayechiguta bila virahu anamanya kpwa nini.

teaser.en: The 'female' dayflower: Digo pick it out from its male partner by its larger, deeper blue flowers.
teaser.sw: Mmea 'jike' wa jamii ya kongwe: Wadigo huutofautisha na mwenzi wake dume kwa maua yake makubwa zaidi ya buluu iliyokolea.
teaser.dg: *Chidzedza* ni mmea wa 'chichetu': Adigo anachitafwautisha na mlumewe kpwa maruwage makulu, ga samawati sana.

teaser.en: A wild cousin of the coca plant, growing quietly in the coastal forest with leaves notched at the tip.
teaser.sw: Binamu wa porini wa mmea wa koka, unaoota kimya kimya katika msitu wa pwani, wenye majani yaliyo na kibonyeo kwenye ncha.
teaser.dg: *Chifumai* ni ndugu wa weruni wa mmea wa *coca*: chinamera matsakani ga pwani bila kumanyikana sana, na makodzage ganakatika chidide kpwenye ntsa.

teaser.en: A little-known shrub of the coffee family that lives in the shade of the coastal forest floor.
teaser.sw: Kichaka kisichojulikana sana cha familia ya mibuni, kinachoishi kivulini kwenye sakafu ya msitu wa pwani.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chidide cha jamii ya kahawa chisichomanyikana sana, chinachokala pepho photsi ya mihi mikulu ya matsaka ga pwani.

teaser.en: An acacia with powdery green-white or orange bark, and on some trees, swollen ant galls that whistle in the wind.
teaser.sw: Mgunga wenye gome la unga-unga la kijani-nyeupe au la machungwa, na kwenye miti mingine, vivimbe vya sisimizi vinavyopiga mluzi upepo unapovuma.
teaser.dg: Muhi wa miya (*acacia*) wenye gopha renye unga, ra rangi ya chijani na nyereru au ya chungbwa. Kpwa mihi yanjina, miya iriyofutuka ambamo nkukala sisimizi inapiga milozi phepho richivuma.

teaser.en: Named after the gall bladder because it is so bitter, and its seeds hang in a neat row under each leaf.
teaser.sw: Umepewa jina la mfuko wa nyongo kwa sababu ni mchungu mno, na mbegu zake huning'inia kwa mstari nadhifu chini ya kila jani.
teaser.dg: Unaihwa dzina ra chifuko cha nyongo kpwa sababu una utsungu sana, na tembeze zinabwadzika mstari sawa-sawa photsi ya chila kodza.

teaser.en: Hooked thorns that grab like a leopard's claws: Digo named this scrambling acacia for exactly that.
teaser.sw: Miiba iliyopinda kama ndoano inayonasa kama makucha ya chui: Wadigo waliupa mgunga huu unaotambaa jina kwa sababu hiyo hasa.
teaser.dg: Miya iriyomyoka inayogbwira dza kombe za tsui: kpwa sababu hiyo hiyo Adigo akachiiha chitsaka hichi cha *acacia* chinachoambala dzina hiri.

search_terms: swahili: shares the name chikombe tsui

teaser.en: A caper bush that Digo lump with an acacia under one name, simply because both claw at you the same way.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha jamii ya caper ambacho Wadigo hukiweka pamoja na mgunga chini ya jina moja, kwa sababu tu vyote viwili hukukwaruza kwa njia ile ile.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha *caper* ambacho Adigo anachiika phamwenga na *acacia* kpwa dzina mwenga, kpwa sababu tu viiri vinakugbwira kpwa miya dza kombe.

teaser.en: A 'little sisal' that is really an arum, sending its leaves straight up from a buried rhizome.
teaser.sw: 'Mkonge mdogo' ambao kwa kweli ni wa familia ya majimbi, unaochipua majani yake moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye kiazi (shina la chini ya ardhi) kilichozikwa.
teaser.dg: 'Konje dide' ambaro kpwa kpweli ni mmea wa jamii ya *arum*: makodzage ganatuluka chocho dzulu kula kpwa *rhizome* iriyo tsini ya ulongo.

teaser.en: The 'male' chikunguni, a tree paired by name with a quite different forest tree.
teaser.sw: *Chikunguni* 'dume', mti uliounganishwa kwa jina na mti tofauti kabisa wa msituni.
teaser.dg: *Chikunguni* 'chilume', muhi unaoikpwa phamwenga kpwa dzina na muhi wanjina wa tsaka tafwauti kabisa.

teaser.en: On a dewy morning walk, a branch of this plant was used to knock the wet off the grass ahead.
teaser.sw: Katika matembezi ya asubuhi yenye umande, tawi la mmea huu lilitumiwa kupiga nyasi zilizo mbele ili kuondoa unyevu.
teaser.dg: Atu achiphiya ligundzu na nyasi zina manena, panda ya mmea uhu yahumirwa kupiga nyasi za mbere ili kuusa manena.

teaser.en: A climbing relative of the monkey oranges, from the same genus that gives strychnine.
teaser.sw: Jamaa anayepanda wa mikwakwa (monkey oranges), kutoka jenasi ile ile inayotoa sumu ya strychnine.
teaser.dg: Mmea unaokpwera, ndugu wa mihi ya *monkey orange*, wa jenasi ihi ihi inayolavya sumu ya *strychnine*.

teaser.en: A leathery-leaved climbing shrub found only on the coast of Kenya and Tanzania.
teaser.sw: Kichaka kinachopanda chenye majani magumu kama ngozi, kinachopatikana tu kwenye pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chinachokpwera, chenye makodza mafu dza chingo, chinachophahikana pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania tu.

teaser.en: The tough, flat-stemmed grass in every footpath and compound, and the wild cousin of finger millet.
teaser.sw: Nyasi ngumu yenye mashina bapa iliyo katika kila njia na kila uwanja, na binamu wa porini wa wimbi.
teaser.dg: Nyasi ngumu zenye milita mibapa, zinazomera kpwenye chila njira na chila mhala, na ni ndugu wa tsaka wa *wimbi*.

teaser.en: A small weed farmers are happy to see: where it grows, the harvest will be good.
teaser.sw: Gugu dogo ambalo wakulima hufurahi kuliona: linapoota, mavuno yatakuwa mazuri.
teaser.dg: Mbondo mdide ambao akurima nkuhererwa kuuona: phatu unaphomera, mavuno gandakala manono.

teaser.en: A sprawling farm weed with spiny little fruits that stab bare feet, and a name meaning 'tough'.
teaser.sw: Gugu la shambani linalotambaa, lenye matunda madogo ya miiba yanayochoma miguu mitupu, na jina linalomaanisha 'gumu'.
teaser.dg: Kpwekpwe ya mindani inayoenea photsi, yenye matunda madide genye miya ganayodunga magulu gasigo na virahu, na dzina renye mana ya 'ngumu'.

teaser.en: Crush a leaf and you will understand all three of its names: two of them are about its bad smell.
teaser.sw: Ponda jani lake na utaelewa majina yake yote matatu: mawili kati yake yanahusu harufu yake mbaya.
teaser.dg: Hopeza kodza na undamanya mana ya madzinage gosi mahahu: mairi kahi yao ni ga arufuye mbii.

teaser.en: 'The smelly one': a shrub whose long white flowers hang like notes on a stave, and whose leaves have a strong smell.
teaser.sw: 'Kinachonuka': kichaka ambacho maua yake marefu meupe huning'inia kama noti za muziki kwenye mistari ya nota, na majani yake yana harufu kali.
teaser.dg: 'Chinachonuka': chitsaka ambacho maruwage mare mereru ganaonekana dza alama za muziki dzulu ya misitari, na makodzage gana arufu kali.

teaser.en: A hooked-thorn scrambler whose small berries turn from red to purple-black, and birds strip them fast.
teaser.sw: Kichaka kinachotambaa chenye miiba ya ndoano, ambacho beri zake ndogo hubadilika kutoka nyekundu hadi zambarau-nyeusi, na ndege huzimaliza haraka.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chinachoambala dzulu ya mimea yanjina, chenye miya ya kufyuka, na matunda madide ganayogaluka kula ga kundu hadi ga zambarau na maru; ndege nkugarya gosi upesi.

teaser.en: A guinea-fowl name nobody can fully explain, and a place in the peace-making rites of Digo homesteads.
teaser.sw: Jina la kanga ambalo hakuna anayeweza kulieleza kikamilifu, na nafasi katika mila za upatanishi za makazi ya Kidigo.
teaser.dg: Dzina ra kanga ambaro takuna awezaye kurieleza sawa-sawa, na nafwasi kpwenye vimila vya kupatanisha atu midzini mwa Adigo.

teaser.en: A wild, aromatic lantana that Digo count as the 'male' partner of a ground-covering vernonia.
teaser.sw: Lantana ya porini yenye harufu, ambayo Wadigo huihesabu kuwa mwenzi 'dume' wa vernonia inayofunika ardhi.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha weruni chenye arufu nono, cha jenasi ya *Lantana*, ambacho Adigo anachiona dza 'mlume' wa *vernonia* inayofwinika tsi.

teaser.en: A rarely seen shrub of the coastal forest understorey, related to the ironwoods.
teaser.sw: Kichaka kisichoonekana mara nyingi cha sehemu ya chini ya msitu wa pwani, jamaa wa miti ya ironwood.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chinachoonekana mara chache, chinachomera photsi ya mihi mikulu ya matsaka ga pwani, na ni ndugu wa mihi inayoihwa *ironwood*.

teaser.en: Its name means 'little witch', and Digo, English, German, Italian and Swahili all independently accuse it of witchcraft.
teaser.sw: Jina lake maana yake ni 'mchawi mdogo', na Kidigo, Kiingereza, Kijerumani, Kiitaliano na Kiswahili, kila kimoja kwa njia yake, kinaushutumu kwa uchawi.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rina mana ya 'mtsai mdide', na Chidigo, Chingereza, Chijerumani, Chitaliana na Chiswahili, chila luga kpwa njiraye, bila kuiga luga yanjina, zinachiona kukala ni mtsai.

teaser.en: A small wild cola tree found only in the forests of south-east Kenya and north-east Tanzania.
teaser.sw: Mkola mdogo wa porini unaopatikana tu katika misitu ya kusini-mashariki mwa Kenya na kaskazini-mashariki mwa Tanzania.
teaser.dg: Muhi mdide wa kola ya weruni, unaophahikana tu kpwenye matsaka ga kusini-mashariki ya Kenya na ga kazikazini-mashariki ya Tanzania.

teaser.en: A dry-country cordia shrub, a cousin of the sandpaper saucer-berry.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha cordia cha nchi kavu, binamu wa sandpaper saucer-berry.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha jenasi ya *Cordia* cha tsi kavu, nduguye *mzondohera nguluwe*.

teaser.en: A fig with leaves as big as dinner plates, often starting life high in another tree.
teaser.sw: Mkuyu wenye majani makubwa kama sahani za chakula, ambao mara nyingi huanza maisha yake juu ya mti mwingine.
teaser.dg: Kuyu yenye makodza makulu dza sahani za chakurya, ambayo mara nyinji inaandza kumera dzulu, kpwenye muhi wanjina.

teaser.en: When it flowers, the bees come buzzing; and when you have a dispute, people say it can end the case in your favour.
teaser.sw: Ukichanua, nyuki huja wakivuma; na ukiwa na ugomvi, watu husema unaweza kumaliza kesi kwa faida yako.
teaser.dg: Chichituluza maruwa, nyuchi anakpwedza achivuma; na uchikala na kesi, atu anagomba kukala chinaweza kumala kesi kpwa fwaidayo.

search_terms: swahili: share the name chivundza kesi

teaser.en: Its leaves turn slippery when crushed, and they were used to polish beads clean.
teaser.sw: Majani yake huteleza yakipondwa, na yalitumika kusafisha shanga.
teaser.dg: Makodzage gachihopezwa ganakala ga uhereza, na nkuhumirwa kutsusa tsalu.

teaser.en: Break a stem and white 'milk' wells up; the Digo name means exactly that.
teaser.sw: Vunja shina na 'maziwa' meupe hububujika; jina la Kidigo lina maana hiyo hasa.
teaser.dg: Uchivundza muhiwe, 'maziya' mereru ganatuluka; na dzinare ra Chidigo manage ni 'maziya' hasa.

teaser.en: A silky-leaved wild relative of the amaranths, and one of the Digo's most common leafy vegetables.
teaser.sw: Ndugu wa porini wa mchicha mwenye majani laini kama hariri, na mojawapo ya mboga za majani zinazotumika zaidi na Wadigo.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa weruni wa jamii ya *mchicha*, wenye makodza ga nyere laini dza hariri, na ni kahi ya mboga za Chidigo za kawaida zaidi.

teaser.en: A slender twiner whose stem snaps at a tug, and whose Digo name says exactly that.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa mwembamba ambao shina lake hukatika ukilivuta kidogo, na jina lake la Kidigo linasema hivyo hasa.
teaser.dg: Mmea mwembamba unaokpwera, ambao muhiwe unadoka uchiumweha chidide tu, na dzina ra Chidigo rinagomba hivyo hasa.

english: Wandering Jew (Pakia); also Benghal dayflower, tropical spiderwort

teaser.en: A creeping weed with sky-blue flowers that open for a morning, then hide away in a folded green hood.
teaser.sw: Gugu linalotambaa lenye maua ya buluu kama anga, yanayofunguka kwa asubuhi moja tu kisha kujificha ndani ya kofia ya kijani iliyokunjwa.
teaser.dg: Kpwekpwe inayoambala yenye maruwa ga samawati, ganayovuguka ligundzu mwenga tu, chisha ganadzifwitsa ndani ya kodza dide ra chijani ririrokundzwa.

teaser.en: Named 'to smoke up', because its flowers seem to rise from the ground all at once, like smoke.
teaser.sw: Unaitwa 'kufuka', kwa sababu maua yake huonekana kuchipuka ardhini yote kwa mara moja, kama moshi.
teaser.dg: Dzinare ni 'kufuka', kpwa sababu maruwage ganaonekana dza ganatuluka photsi phamwenga gosi, dza mosi unavyofuka.

teaser.en: The seaside futswe: a rough-leaved, yellow-flowered daisy that sprawls over the sand just above the tide.
teaser.sw: Futswe wa pwani: ua la jamii ya alizeti lenye majani makwaruzo na maua ya manjano, linalotanda mchangani juu kidogo ya mpaka wa maji kujaa.
teaser.dg: *Futswe ra pwani*: mmea wenye makodza ganayokaraza na maruwa ga rangi ya mandano dza ga *daisy*, unaotandazika dzulu ya mtsanga, dzulu tu ya phatu madzi ga kuodzala ganaphofika.

teaser.en: A climber with thick, smooth, bright green stems that stay green for years, and that has a reputation as a poisonous plant.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa wenye mashina manene, laini, ya kijani angavu yanayobaki kijani kwa miaka mingi, na unaojulikana kuwa mmea wenye sumu.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa kukpwera wenye mihi minono, laini na ya chijani inayong'ala, inayosala ya chijani kpwa myaka minji, na unamanyikana kukala ni mmea wa sumu.

teaser.en: 'Stomach of the pig': a bush legume whose twisting stems reminded someone of a pig's coiled insides.
teaser.sw: 'Tumbo la nguruwe': mmea wa jamii ya kunde wa vichakani ambao mashina yake yanayojisokota yalimkumbusha mtu matumbo ya nguruwe yaliyojiviringa.
teaser.dg: 'Humbo ra nguluwe': chitsaka cha jamii ya kunde, ambacho mihiye inayobeta yamtambukiza mutu mahumbo ga nguluwe ganayodzizunguluka.

teaser.en: A plant that looks like a burr-weed but has no burrs, so the Digo named it half jirimata, half futswe.
teaser.sw: Mmea unaofanana na gugu lenye miiba-ndoano lakini hauna miiba hiyo, kwa hivyo Wadigo waliupa jina nusu jirimata, nusu futswe.
teaser.dg: Unaonekana dza mbondo wenye matunda ga miya, ela tauna miya, kpwa hivyo Adigo anauiha *jirimata futswe*: seemu mwenga *jirimata*, seemu yanjina *futswe*.

search_terms: hypoestes aristata  sol. ex roem. & schult.

teaser.en: The 'female' burr-weed, whose hooked fruit-clusters cling to clothes and fur but are gentler than its 'male' partner's.
teaser.sw: Jirimata 'jike', ambaye vishada vya matunda yake vyenye ndoano hunasa kwenye nguo na manyoya ya wanyama, lakini si vikali kama vya mwenzake 'dume'.
teaser.dg: *Jirimata* ya 'chichetu': makundi ga matundage, genye ntsa dza viloo, ganagbwirira nguwo na nyere za nyama, ela tagalumiza dza ga *jirimata* ya 'chilume'.

teaser.en: The 'male' jirimata: a grass whose spiny burrs are sharp enough to earn a place among the thorny plants.
teaser.sw: Jirimata 'dume': nyasi ambayo miiba ya vishada vyake ni mikali kiasi cha kuiweka miongoni mwa mimea ya miiba.
teaser.dg: *Jirimata* ya 'chilume': nyasi ambayo miya ya vitswavye ni mikali sana, hata ikaikpwa kahi ya mimea ya miya.

teaser.en: An English word that has settled into Digo: kabichi, the cabbage, and its leafy cousin that 'pushes the week'.
teaser.sw: Neno la Kiingereza lililotulia katika Kidigo: kabichi, na binamu yake wa majani 'anayesukuma wiki'.
teaser.dg: Neno ra Chingereza rikakala ra Chidigo: *kabichi*, na nduguye wa makodza, *sukuma wiki*, 'kusukuma jumwa'.

teaser.en: A crunchy orange root from far away, whose English name came along with it into Digo.
teaser.sw: Mzizi wa rangi ya machungwa unaokatika kwa mkwaruzo, kutoka mbali, ambao jina lake la Kiingereza liliingia nao katika Kidigo.
teaser.dg: Muzi wa rangi ya chungbwa unaobebenwa, wa kula tsi za kure, na dzinare ra Chingereza redza nao hadi Chidigo.

teaser.en: The 'male' kongwe: a dayflower judged male because its little flowers are smaller and duller than its partner's.
teaser.sw: Kongwe 'dume': mmea wa jenasi Commelina unaohesabiwa kuwa dume kwa sababu maua yake madogo ni madogo zaidi na yasiyong'aa kama ya mwenzake.
teaser.dg: *Kongwe* ya 'chilume': mmea wa *Commelina* (*dayflower*) ambao Adigo anauona ni wa chilume kpwa sababu maruwage madide ni madide zaidi, na rangiye tainang'ala dza ya maruwa ga myawe.

teaser.en: One huge, lacy leaf on a mottled stalk with a 'knee', rising from a buried tuber on the forest floor.
teaser.sw: Jani moja kubwa lenye mapambo kama lasi juu ya kikonyo chenye madoadoa na 'goti', likichipuka kutoka kiazi kilichozikwa ardhini msituni.
teaser.dg: Kodza mwenga kulu, rinaloganyika vipande vinji, dzulu ya mlita wenye madowa na 'goti', rinalomera kula chiazi chiricho tsini tsakani.

teaser.en: 'Climbing cotton': a milky-sapped liana whose pods burst into tufts of silky white floss.
teaser.sw: 'Pamba inayotambaa': mtambaa wenye utomvu mweupe ambao maganda yake hupasuka na kutoa vishungi vya pamba nyeupe laini kama hariri.
teaser.dg: 'Pamba ya kukpwera': libugu renye maziya, ambaro makakayage ganaahuka na kulavya nyuzi-nyuzi nyereru, laini dza hariri.

teaser.en: A small wild legume of the indigo genus, known to Digo people by the look of its leaves.
teaser.sw: Mmea mdogo wa porini wa jamii ya kunde, wa jenasi ya mnili, unaojulikana na Wadigo kwa sura ya majani yake.
teaser.dg: Mmea mdide wa weruni wa jamii ya kunde, wa jenasi ya *Indigofera*, unaomanyikana ni Adigo kpwa umbo ra makodzage.

teaser.en: 'The cat's testicles': a frank Digo name for a shrub whose paired, rounded fruits leave little to the imagination.
teaser.sw: 'Mapumbu ya paka': jina la Kidigo lisilo na kificho kwa kichaka ambacho matunda yake ya mviringo yaliyo kwa jozi hayaachi mengi ya kukisia.
teaser.dg: *Machende ga mnyau*: dzina ra Chidigo risirofitsa chitu, ra chitsaka ambacho matundage ga mviringo ganamera mairi-mairi.

teaser.en: A wild yam that hangs purple 'potatoes' from its twining stems as well as growing one underground.
teaser.sw: Kiazi-pori kinachoning'iniza 'viazi' vya zambarau kwenye mashina yake yanayojizungusha, na pia kukuza kimoja chini ya ardhi.
teaser.dg: Chiazi tsaka chinachokpwera, chinacholavya 'viazi' vya zambarau dzulu ya mihiye, na piya chiazi chimwenga tsini.

teaser.en: The bush's toilet paper: a shrub whose soft, velvety leaves gave it a very practical Digo name.
teaser.sw: Karatasi ya chooni ya porini: kichaka ambacho majani yake laini kama mahameli yameupa jina la Kidigo lenye manufaa ya moja kwa moja.
teaser.dg: Karatasi ya choo ya weruni: chitsaka ambacho makodzage laini dza nguwo ganachipha dzina ra Chidigo rinaroeleza kaziye.

teaser.en: One shrub, two household jobs: its soft leaves serve as toilet paper, and also polish beads.
teaser.sw: Kichaka kimoja, kazi mbili za nyumbani: majani yake laini hutumika kama karatasi ya chooni, na pia kung'arisha shanga.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chimwenga, kazi mbiri za kaya: makodzage laini nkuhumirwa dza karatasi ya choo, na piya kutsusa tsalu.

teaser.en: The 'small rib plant', linked by name and use to nyuni wa mbavu, the convulsions that Digo belief ties to certain birds.
teaser.sw: 'Mmea mdogo wa mbavu', unaohusishwa kwa jina na matumizi na nyuni wa mbavu, degedege ambalo imani ya Kidigo inalihusisha na ndege fulani.
teaser.dg: 'Mmea mdide wa mbavu', unaoungwa kpwa dzina na kpwa matumizi na *nyuni wa mbavu*, ukongo wa ana adide wa kugbwa na kukakama ambao Adigo anaamini unarehwa ni ndege anjina.

teaser.en: A wild grapevine with a 'chewable' stem, as its Digo name says.
teaser.sw: Mzabibu pori wenye shina 'linalotafunika', kama jina lake la Kidigo linavyosema.
teaser.dg: Mzabibu wa weruni wenye muhi 'unaobebeneka', dza dzinare ra Chidigo rinavyogomba.

teaser.en: Touch a leaf and it folds shut and droops; Digo people recognise it by exactly this habit.
teaser.sw: Gusa jani nalo hujifunga na kulegea; Wadigo huutambua mmea huu kwa tabia hiyo hasa.
teaser.dg: Uchiguta kodza, rinadzikundza na kugbwadzika photsi; Adigo anaumanya mmea uhu kpwa tabiya ihi hasa.

teaser.en: A miniature 'palm' a hand's breadth tall whose leaflets fold down when touched.
teaser.sw: 'Mnazi' mdogo mno wenye urefu wa kiganja, ambao vijani vyake hujikunja chini ukiviguswa.
teaser.dg: Mmea mdide dza 'muhi wa jamii ya mnazi', urewe ni dza upana wa fumba, na makodzage madide ganadzikundza photsi uchiuguta.

teaser.en: A glossy forest shrub that, to Digo eyes, grows like a garden vegetable.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha msituni chenye majani yanayong'aa ambacho, machoni mwa Wadigo, hukua kama mboga ya bustanini.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha tsakani chenye makodza ganayong'ala, ambacho kpwa matso ga Adigo chinamera dza mboga ya mundani.

teaser.en: Its brilliant 'flowers' are really leaves, yet Digo people count them as flowers, and Pakia used it to show why.
teaser.sw: 'Maua' yake yenye rangi angavu kwa kweli ni majani, lakini Wadigo huyahesabu kuwa maua, na Pakia aliutumia mmea huu kueleza sababu.
teaser.dg: 'Maruwage' ganayong'ala kpwa kpweli ni makodza, ela Adigo anagatala dza maruwa, na Pakia wauhumira kuonyesa sababu.

teaser.en: A milky-sapped liana with hook-like tendrils, whose flexible but strong stems go into furniture.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa wenye utomvu mweupe kama maziwa na vikonyo vyenye umbo la kulabu, ambao mashina yake yanayopindika lakini imara hutumika kutengeneza samani.
teaser.dg: *Libugu* renye maziya na nyuzi za kugbwirira dza viloo, ambaro militaye ya kundzika ela yenye nguvu nkuhenderwa vyombo vya nyumba.

teaser.en: The 'gun' shrub: Digo children load its small round fruits as bullets in their toy guns.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha 'bunduki': watoto wa Kidigo hutumia matunda yake madogo ya mviringo kama risasi za bunduki zao za kuchezea.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha 'bunduchi': ana a Chidigo nkuhumira matunda madide ga duara dza risasi za bunduchi zao za kuchezera.

teaser.en: A wiry roadside weed whose name means 'extra strength', the strength that healers add to a person by unseen means.
teaser.sw: Gugu gumu kama waya la kando ya barabara ambalo jina lake linamaanisha 'nguvu za ziada', nguvu ambazo waganga humwongezea mtu kwa njia zisizoonekana.
teaser.dg: Mbondo nyifu ya kanda-kanda ya njira, ambayo dzinare rinagomba 'nguvu za kuenjerezwa', nguvu ambazo aganga nkumuenjereza mutu kpwa njira zisizoonekana.

teaser.en: Its fruits have two long wings and spin to the ground like helicopter blades.
teaser.sw: Matunda yake yana mabawa mawili marefu na huzunguka yakishuka chini kama rafu za helikopta.
teaser.dg: Matundage gana mapha mairi mare, na ganazunguluka uchigbwa photsi dza mapanga ga *helikopta*.

teaser.en: A spiny, papery-barked myrrh relative that Digo people recognise by its three-part leaves and its stem.
teaser.sw: Jamaa wa manemane mwenye miiba na gome kama karatasi, ambaye Wadigo humtambua kwa majani yake ya vipande vitatu na shina lake.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha jamii imwenga na *mbambara*, chenye miya na gopha dza karatasi, ambacho Adigo nkuchimanya kpwa makodzage genye makodza madide mahahu, na kpwa kolore.

teaser.en: The 'forest lime' that bleeds milk: a glossy-leaved forest tree with two names, one for its look and one for its latex.
teaser.sw: 'Mdimu wa msituni' unaotoa maziwa: mti wa msituni wenye majani yanayong'aa na majina mawili, moja kwa sura yake na jingine kwa utomvu wake.
teaser.dg: 'Mdimu wa tsakani' unaolavya maziya: muhi wa tsakani wenye makodza ganayong'ala, na madzina mairi, rimwenga kpwa vira unavyoonekana na ranjina kpwa maziyage.

teaser.en: Another 'forest lime': a glossy, aromatic-leaved tree that Digo people link to the lime by sight and smell.
teaser.sw: 'Mdimu wa msituni' mwingine: mti wenye majani yanayong'aa na yenye harufu, ambao Wadigo huuhusisha na mdimu kwa sura na harufu.
teaser.dg: 'Mdimu wa tsakani' wanjina: muhi wenye makodza ganayong'ala na ga arufu nono, ambao Adigo anauona kukala ni ndugu wa mdimu kpwa matso na kpwa arufu.

teaser.en: A succulent vine whose fleshy stems snap at a touch, so the Digo call it 'breaking'.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa wenye mashina yenye maji mengi yanayokatika ukiyagusa tu, ndiyo maana Wadigo huuita 'kukatika'.
teaser.dg: Mmea unaokpwera wenye madzi manji ndani, ambao militaye ya nyama inadoka uchiiguta tu, kpwa hivyo Adigo anauiha 'kudoka'.

teaser.en: A forest Cissus, named by science only in 1993, whose young leaves come up crimson-purple.
teaser.sw: *Cissus* wa msituni, aliyepewa jina la kisayansi mwaka 1993 tu, ambaye majani yake machanga huchipuka yakiwa na rangi ya zambarau-nyekundu.
teaser.dg: *Cissus* wa tsakani, ambao asayansi akaupha dzina mwaka 1993 tu, na makodzage maphya ganatuluka ga kundu-zambarau.

teaser.en: A climber with fleshy, five-angled stems that snap easily, the third Cissus that Digo people call 'breaking'.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa wenye mashina ya nyama yenye pembe tano yanayokatika kwa urahisi, *Cissus* wa tatu ambaye Wadigo humwita 'kukatika'.
teaser.dg: Mmea unaokpwera wenye milita ya nyama ya pembe tsano inayodoka upesi; ni *Cissus* wa hahu ambao Adigo anauiha 'kudoka'.

teaser.en: A scrambling bush-vine with two Digo names and round orange fruits.
teaser.sw: Kichaka-mtambaa chenye majina mawili ya Kidigo na matunda ya mviringo ya rangi ya machungwa.
teaser.dg: Mmea unaoambala dzulu ya vitsaka, wenye madzina mairi ga Chidigo na matunda ga duara ga rangi ya chungbwa.

teaser.en: A rare forest relative of the 'miracle berry', found only in a handful of coastal forests in Kenya and Tanzania.
teaser.sw: Jamaa adimu wa msituni wa 'tunda la ajabu' (miracle berry), anayepatikana tu katika misitu michache ya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.
teaser.dg: *Mdulu* ni muhi adimu wa tsakani, nduguye 'miracle berry', na unaphahikana kpwenye matsaka machache tu ga pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.

teaser.en: 'It ties up animals': a twining forest climber that grows so tangled it is said to snare any animal walking through.
teaser.sw: 'Hufunga wanyama': mtambaa wa msituni unaojiviringa na kusokotana kiasi kwamba husemekana kumnasa mnyama yeyote anayepita ndani yake.
teaser.dg: 'Unafunga nyama': mmea wa tsakani wa kukpwera, unaodzizunguluka sana hata nkugombwa unagbwira chila nyama anayetsupa kahi yakpwe.

teaser.en: A giant liana with pods longer than a person is tall; its big, shiny seeds float across oceans and wash up on beaches.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa mkubwa sana wenye maganda marefu kuliko kimo cha mtu; mbegu zake kubwa zinazong'aa huelea kuvuka bahari na kusukumwa ufuoni.
teaser.dg: Mmea mkulu sana wa kukpwera wenye makakaya mare kuriko mutu ariyeima; tembeze kulu zinazong'ala nkuelea kutsupa bahari na kufika ufuwoni.

teaser.en: A dry-country shrub that covers its bare twigs in pinkish-white flowers before its leaves appear.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha nchi kavu kinachofunika vijiti vyake vitupu kwa maua meupe-waridi kabla majani yake hayajachipuka.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha tsi kavu chinachofwinika pandaze zisizo na makodza kpwa maruwa ga pinki na nyereru kabla ya makodza kuzuka.

teaser.en: A shrub whose white star-flowers have hairy, fringed petals, as if each one were edged with fine lace.
teaser.sw: Kichaka ambacho maua yake meupe yenye umbo la nyota yana petali zenye manyoya na pindo, kana kwamba kila moja limepambwa kwa lesi nyembamba.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chenye maruwa ga nyereru ga umbo ra nyota, ambago malage gana nyere kanda-kanda, dza kukala chila ruwa rikashonwa kanda-kanda kpwa nyuzi nyembamba.

teaser.en: A climber of the grape family that Digo speakers can name by taste alone: its leaves are sour.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa wa familia ya mizabibu ambao wasemaji wa Kidigo wanaweza kuutaja kwa ladha peke yake: majani yake ni machachu.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa kukpwera wa jamii ya mzabibu, ambao atu anaogomba Chidigo anaweza kuumanya kpwa ladha tu: makodzage ni ga ngbwadu.

teaser.en: A thorny acacia whose name is shared by Digo, Duruma, Giriama and Swahili alike.
teaser.sw: Mgunga wenye miiba ambao jina lake linashirikiwa na Kidigo, Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili kwa pamoja.
teaser.dg: *Mgunga* ni *acacia* yenye miya, na dzinare ni sawa kpwa Chidigo, Chiduruma, Chigiriama na Chiswahili.

teaser.en: Every leaf joint carries two thorns, one straight and one hooked: easy to catch on, hard to get free from.
teaser.sw: Kila kiungo cha jani kina miiba miwili, mmoja ulionyooka na mwingine wenye ndoano: ni rahisi kunaswa, ni vigumu kujinasua.
teaser.dg: Chila phatu kodza rinaphogbwirana na panda phana miya miiri, mmwenga uriogoloka na wanjina uriopindika dza chiloo: ni rahisi kugbwirwa nayo, ni vigumu kudziusa.

teaser.en: Fresh twigs travel by lorry from the highlands to coast towns every day, to be chewed as a stimulant.
teaser.sw: Vijiti vibichi husafirishwa kwa malori kila siku kutoka nyanda za juu hadi miji ya pwani, ili kutafunwa kama kichangamshi.
teaser.dg: Chila siku maphungo dza garivyo nkutsukulwa kpwa malori kula tsi za dzulu za bara hadi midzi ya pwani, ili gaafunwe dza chitu cha kumpha mutu nguvu.

teaser.en: A garden flower from the Americas that escaped and now covers the coast; northern and southern Digo even call it different names.
teaser.sw: Ua la bustanini kutoka Amerika lililotoroka na sasa limeenea pwani nzima; Wadigo wa kaskazini na wa kusini hata huliita kwa majina tofauti.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa maruwa wa mindani uriorehwa kula Amerika, urioenea kondze ya mindani na sambi unafwinika pwani; Adigo a kazikazini na a kusini hata anauiha kpwa madzina tafwauti.

teaser.en: A small rattlepod of the pea family: shake a dry pod and the seeds rattle inside.
teaser.sw: Mmea mdogo wa njuga (rattlepod) wa jamii ya kunde: tikisa ganda lililokauka na mbegu hulia ndani yake.
teaser.dg: Mmea mdide wa jamii ya kunde wenye makakaya ganayopiga kululu: uchidindirisa kakaya kavu, tembe zinapiga kululu ndani.

teaser.en: A milky-sapped relative of the shea tree, hidden in the coastal thickets of Kenya and Tanzania.
teaser.sw: Jamaa wa mti wa shea mwenye utomvu kama maziwa, aliyejificha katika vichaka vya pwani vya Kenya na Tanzania.
teaser.dg: Muhi wenye maziya wa jamii imwenga na *shea tree*, uriofwitsika vitsakani vya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.

teaser.en: A bright hedge flower that even goats won't touch: every part of the plant is poisonous.
teaser.sw: Ua angavu la ua wa nyumba ambalo hata mbuzi hawaligusi: kila sehemu ya mmea huu ina sumu.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa lichigo wenye maruwa ganayoala, ambao hata mbuzi taauguta: chila seemu ya mmea hinyu ina sumu.

teaser.en: The climbing cousin of mkone: same kind of leaves, but it reaches up into the bush instead of standing on its own.
teaser.sw: Binamu wa mkone anayetambaa: majani ya aina moja, lakini hupanda juu ya vichaka badala ya kusimama peke yake.
teaser.dg: *Mkone* unaokpwera: makodzage ni ga aina imwenga na ga *mkone*, ela unakpwera dzulu vitsakani badala ya kuima macheye.

teaser.en: The 'black mkongolo': named not for any relationship, but because its dark bark matches the inner bark of another tree.
teaser.sw: 'Mkongolo mweusi': umepewa jina hili si kwa sababu ya uhusiano wowote, bali kwa sababu gome lake jeusi linalingana na gome la ndani la mti mwingine.
teaser.dg: *Mkongolo* 'mwiru': tauihwa hivyo kpwa sababu ni ndugu na muhi wanjina, ela kpwa sababu gophare riru rinahalana na gopha ra ndani ra muhi wanjina.

teaser.en: A wild grape vine of the coastal forest edge, climbing by tendrils and hanging with dark berries.
teaser.sw: Mzabibu mwitu wa pembezoni mwa misitu ya pwani, unaopanda kwa vikonyo na kuning'iniza matunda meusi.
teaser.dg: Mzabibu wa weruni wa kanda-kanda ya matsaka ga pwani, unaokpwera kpwa nyuzi za kugbwirira na unaokala na mabunda ga matunda madide maru.

teaser.en: Crush a leaf and sniff: the smell is so sharp that its name says it 'smacks the brain'.
teaser.sw: Finyanga jani na unuse: harufu yake ni kali mno kiasi kwamba jina lake linasema 'hupiga ubongo'.
teaser.dg: Hopeza kodza na urinuse: arufuye ni kali sana hata dzinare rinagomba 'inakota wongo'.

teaser.en: A forest shrub believed to do its growing at night, when no one is watching.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha msituni kinachoaminika kukua usiku, wakati hakuna anayekiona.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha tsakani ambacho atu anaamini kukala chinakula usiku, wakati takuna mutu anayelola.

teaser.en: A citrus-family tree whose three-part leaves smell of lemon when crushed, with wood hard enough to be called ironwood.
teaser.sw: Mti wa familia ya michungwa ambao majani yake ya sehemu tatu hunukia limau yakipondwa, na mbao zake ni ngumu kiasi cha kuitwa 'mti-chuma'.
teaser.dg: Muhi wa jamii ya michungbwa, ambao makodzage ga seemu tahu ganalavya arufu dza ya ndimu gachihopezwa, na nyama za muhi uhu ni ngumu hata kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *ironwood*, 'muhi wa chuma'.

teaser.en: A creeping finger grass whose seed heads spread out like the fingers of a hand.
teaser.sw: Nyasi inayotambaa ambayo vishada vyake vya mbegu hutawanyika kama vidole vya mkono.
teaser.dg: Nyasi inayoambala photsi, ambayo vitswavye vya tembe vinatawanyika dza vyala vya mkpwono.

teaser.en: Every branch forks into exactly two, so regularly that Digo speakers identify it by its branching alone.
teaser.sw: Kila tawi hugawanyika kuwa mawili hasa, kwa utaratibu kiasi kwamba Wadigo huutambua kwa mpangilio wa matawi yake peke yake.
teaser.dg: Chila panda inaganyika kukala panda mbiri tu, sawa-sawa sana, hata atu anaogomba Chidigo nkuumanya kpwa vira pandaze zinavyoganyika bahi.

teaser.en: Seen as the 'male' of the white-berry bush, and known in English for smelling like boiled potatoes at dusk.
teaser.sw: Huonwa kama 'dume' wa kichaka cha matunda meupe, na kwa Kiingereza hujulikana kwa kunukia kama viazi vilivyochemshwa wakati wa magharibi.
teaser.dg: Adigo nkuuona dza 'mlume' wa *mkpwamba*, chitsaka cha matunda mereru; kpwa Chingereza unamanyikana kpwa sababu dziloni unalavya arufu dza ya viazi virivyookohwa.

teaser.en: The 'black mlala', told apart from its relatives by the darkness of its bark.
teaser.sw: 'Mlala mweusi', unaotofautishwa na jamaa zake kwa weusi wa gome lake.
teaser.dg: '*Mlala* mwiru', unaotafwautishwa na nduguze kpwa gophare riru zaidi.

teaser.en: Its scent is famous in perfume; at the coast its flowers are worn on clothes and in hair, and scattered on beds.
teaser.sw: Harufu yake ni maarufu katika manukato; huku pwani maua yake huvaliwa kwenye nguo na nywele, na hutawanywa vitandani.
teaser.dg: Arufuye inamanyikana sana kpwenye marashi; pwani maruwage nkuvwalwa nguwoni na nyereni, na nkumwagwa vitandani.

teaser.en: Named for laying the spirits of the dead to rest in peace.
teaser.sw: Umepewa jina kwa kuzilaza roho za wafu zipumzike kwa amani.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rinatuluka kpwa kuzilaza koma za akufwa zioye kpwa amani.

teaser.en: A coastal shrub that shares one name with a neighbour and another with the plants used for arrow shafts.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha pwani kinachoshiriki jina moja na jirani yake, na jina lingine na mimea inayotumiwa kutengeneza mipini ya mishale.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha pwani chinachokala na dzina mwenga na jiraniye, na dzina ranjina sawa na mimea inayohumirwa kutsonga *nyomba*.

teaser.en: One shrub, four Digo names, and one of them shared with a different neighbour.
teaser.sw: Kichaka kimoja, majina manne ya Kidigo, na moja kati yake linashirikiwa na jirani mwingine.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chimwenga, madzina mane ga Chidigo, na dzina mwenga kahi yao ni ra jirani wanjina tafwauti.

teaser.en: A rare wild cola tree known from only a few coastal forest patches, mostly the kayas.
teaser.sw: Mkola pori adimu unaojulikana katika vipande vichache tu vya misitu ya pwani, hasa kaya.
teaser.dg: Muhi adimu wa kola ya weruni unaomanyikana kpwenye vipande vichache tu vya matsaka ga pwani, sana sana kaya.

teaser.en: A ball of scarlet flowers on a single stem, and a name that warns it is as dangerous as a snake.
teaser.sw: Mpira wa maua mekundu kama damu juu ya shina moja, na jina linaloonya kuwa ni hatari kama nyoka.
teaser.dg: Chitswa cha maruwa ga kundu dzulu ya mlita mmwenga, na dzina rinaloonya kukala ni wa hatari dza nyoka.

teaser.en: A wild ginger of the forest floor, given the same snake-warning name as the blood lily.
teaser.sw: Tangawizi pori ya sakafu ya msitu, iliyopewa jina lilelile la onyo la nyoka kama *blood lily*.
teaser.dg: Tangawizi ya weruni inayomera photsi tsakani, iriyohewa dzina ra kuonya ra nyoka dza ra *blood lily*.

teaser.en: To a sunbird, this mistletoe is as precious as a coconut palm is to people.
teaser.sw: Kwa chozi, kimelea hiki ni cha thamani kama mnazi ulivyo kwa binadamu.
teaser.dg: Kpwa tsozi, mmea uhu una samani dza mnazi kpwa atu.

teaser.en: A small tree with bright yellow inner bark, and one of two quite different trees that share one Digo name.
teaser.sw: Mti mdogo wenye gome la ndani la manjano angavu, na mmoja kati ya miti miwili tofauti kabisa inayoshiriki jina moja la Kidigo.
teaser.dg: Muhi mdide wenye gopha ra ndani ra rangi ya mandano inayong'ala, na mwenga wa mihi miiri tafwauti sana ambayo ina dzina mwenga ra Chidigo.

teaser.en: Its species name means 'fever-chaser': across Africa its bark is a traditional remedy for fever.
teaser.sw: Jina la spishi yake maana yake ni 'mfukuza homa': kote Afrika gome lake ni dawa ya asili ya homa.
teaser.dg: Dzinare ra aina, *febrifuga*, rina mana ya 'mwinga homa': Afrika yosi gophare ni muhaso wa chienyeji wa homa.

teaser.en: Digo speakers call it the 'hairy' and 'male' mngweni, though botanists put it in a different genus altogether.
teaser.sw: Wadigo huuita mngweni 'mwenye manyoya' na 'dume', ingawa wataalamu wa mimea wanauweka katika jenasi tofauti kabisa.
teaser.dg: Atu anaogomba Chidigo anauiha *mngweni* 'wenye nyere' na *mngweni* 'mlume', ela asayansi a mimea anauika kpwenye jenasi yanjina kabisa.

teaser.en: A creeping coastal grass that knits the sand together into a soft green mat.
teaser.sw: Nyasi ya pwani inayotambaa na kuushikanisha mchanga kuwa zulia laini la kijani.
teaser.dg: Nyasi ya pwani inayoambala photsi, inayogbwira mtsanga phamwenga na kukala dza mcheka laini wa chijani.

teaser.en: A rare climbing shrub of the southern Kenya coast, one of three Keetia species that share the name mnyundzu.
teaser.sw: Kichaka adimu kinachopanda cha pwani ya kusini mwa Kenya, mojawapo ya spishi tatu za Keetia zinazoshiriki jina mnyundzu.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka adimu chinachokpwera cha pwani ya kusini ya Kenya; ni aina mwenga kahi ya aina tahu za Keetia zinazoihwa *mnyundzu*.

teaser.en: One of three Keetia shrubs that Digo speakers group together under one name.
teaser.sw: Mojawapo ya vichaka vitatu vya Keetia ambavyo Wadigo huviweka pamoja chini ya jina moja.
teaser.dg: Chimwenga kahi ya vitsaka vihahu vya Keetia ambavyo atu anaogomba Chidigo nkuviika phamwenga kpwa dzina mwenga.

teaser.en: A scrambling shrub of the Zanzibar and Kenya coast, one of three plants that share the name mnyundzu.
teaser.sw: Kichaka kinachotambaa cha pwani ya Zanzibar na Kenya, mojawapo ya mimea mitatu inayoshiriki jina mnyundzu.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chinachoambala dzulu ya mimea yanjina cha pwani ya Zanzibar na Kenya; ni mmea mmwenga kahi ya mimea mihahu inayoihwa *mnyundzu*.

teaser.en: Its leaves go slippery when crushed, and they are rubbed on beads to clean them.
teaser.sw: Majani yake huteleza yakipondwa, na husuguliwa kwenye shanga ili kuzisafisha.
teaser.dg: Makodzage gachihopezwa ganakala na uhereza, na ushanga nkusingwa kpwa makodza higa ili kuutsusa.

teaser.en: Its Digo name says the wood cracks easily; its seeds shine like blue-black metal.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo linasema mbao zake hupasuka kwa urahisi; mbegu zake hung'aa kama chuma cha rangi ya buluu-nyeusi.
teaser.dg: Dzinare ra Chidigo rinagomba kukala nyama za muhi uhu nkupalika upesi; tembeze zinang'ala dza chuma cha rangi nyiru iriyo na samawati.

teaser.en: The 'guava of the forest': not a guava at all, but a forest shrub that reminds people of one.
teaser.sw: 'Mpera wa msituni': si mpera hata kidogo, bali ni kichaka cha msituni kinachowakumbusha watu mpera.
teaser.dg: 'Mpera wa tsakani': si mpera hata chidide, ela ni chitsaka cha tsakani chinachotambukiza atu mpera.

teaser.en: Snap a twig and orange sap oozes out; Digo speakers liken this small tree to a forest guava.
teaser.sw: Vunja kitawi na utomvu wa rangi ya chungwa hutiririka; Wadigo huufananisha mti huu mdogo na mpera wa msituni.
teaser.dg: Vundza liphungo, na utomvu wa rangi ya chungbwa unatuluka chidide-chidide; atu anaogomba Chidigo nkuulinganisha muhi uhu mdide na mpera wa tsakani.

teaser.en: An aromatic bush shrub with catkin-like spikes, and a Digo name it shares with two other plants.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha porini chenye harufu nzuri na masuke yaliyo kama vishungi, na jina la Kidigo kinachoshiriki na mimea mingine miwili.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha weruni chenye arufu, chenye milita mifupi ya maruwa madide, na dzina ra Chidigo rinarohumirwa piya kpwa mimea miiri yanjina.

teaser.en: A forest shrub with coffee-like leaves, studied for compounds that fight skin fungi.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha msituni chenye majani yanayofanana na ya mbuni, kinachochunguzwa kwa kemikali zake zinazopambana na fangasi wa ngozi.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha tsakani chenye makodza dza ga kahawa, ambacho kemikalize zinahenderwa utafiti kpwa kuolaga fangasi za ngozi.

teaser.en: The 'perfume-root' tree: its roots are recognised by smell, though only by the oldest Digo now.
teaser.sw: Mti wa 'mzizi wa manukato': mizizi yake hutambuliwa kwa harufu, ingawa sasa ni wazee kabisa wa Kidigo tu wanaoijua.
teaser.dg: Muhi wa 'mizi ya arufu nono': miziye nkumanyikana kpwa arufu, ela sambi ni Adigo azehe kabisa tu ndio anaoimanya.

teaser.en: A 'false' wild yam: so like the edible mriga that its name warns you it isn't the real thing.
teaser.sw: Kiazi kikuu pori 'bandia': kinafanana mno na mriga unaoliwa kiasi kwamba jina lake linakuonya kuwa si wenyewe halisi.
teaser.dg: Mriga wa weruni 'wa handzo': unahalana sana na *mriga* unaoriwa hata dzinare rinakuonya kukala sio mriga wa kpweli.

teaser.en: Its Digo name calls it the guardian of the water pond, and that is exactly where you find it standing.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo linauita mlinzi wa bwawa la maji, na hapo ndipo hasa utakapoukuta ukiwa umesimama.
teaser.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo rinauiha 'mrindzi wa ziya ra madzi', na ziyani ndiko hasa unakouona uchiima.

teaser.en: A roadside weed with a long green whip of a flower spike, dotted each morning with a few small blue flowers.
teaser.sw: Gugu la kando ya barabara lenye shada refu la kijani la ua kama mjeledi, linalopambwa kila asubuhi na maua machache madogo ya buluu.
teaser.dg: Mbondo wa kanda-kanda ya njira wenye mlita mure wa chijani dza chikoto, ambao chila ligundzu unakala na maruwa machache madide ga samawati.

teaser.en: The soap plant: its fruits were a homemade substitute for detergent.
teaser.sw: Mmea wa sabuni: matunda yake yalikuwa mbadala wa sabuni uliotengenezwa nyumbani.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa sabuni: matundage kala ganahumirwa dza sabuni ya kaya badala ya sabuni ya kugula.

teaser.en: A small ebony with wood so hard that botanists named it after iron.
teaser.sw: Mpingo mdogo wenye mbao ngumu kiasi kwamba wataalamu wa mimea waliupa jina la chuma.
teaser.dg: Muhi mdide wa jamii ya mbara wenye nyama za muhi ngumu sana hata asayansi a mimea akauiha dzina kula kpwa chuma.

teaser.en: A twining Grewia whose second name, Mbavubavu, points to a healer's remedy for convulsions of the ribs.
teaser.sw: Grewia inayojisokota, ambayo jina lake la pili, Mbavubavu, linaashiria dawa ya mganga kwa degedege la mbavu.
teaser.dg: Grewia unaodzilinga-linga ambao dzinare ra phiri, Mbavubavu, rinaonyesa dawa ya mganga ya nyuni za mbavu.

teaser.en: One shrub, three Digo names: the twiner, Msuko, and the rib plant used against convulsions.
teaser.sw: Kichaka kimoja, majina matatu ya Kidigo: kinachojisokota, Msuko, na mmea wa mbavu unaotumika dhidi ya degedege.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chimwenga, madzina mahahu ga Chidigo: Msokoto, mmea unaodzilinga-linga; Msuko; na Mbavubavu, mmea wa mbavu unaohumirwa kpwa nyuni.

teaser.en: The wild kapok: a slippery-barked giant whose pods burst into red-brown fluff and whose roasted seeds taste like groundnuts.
teaser.sw: Msufi mwitu: jitu lenye gome linaloteleza, ambalo maganda yake hupasuka na kutoa sufi ya rangi nyekundu-kahawia, na mbegu zake zilizokaangwa zina ladha kama karanga.
teaser.dg: Msufi wa weruni: muhi mkulu wenye gopha ra kuhereza ambao makakayage ganaahuka kulavya sufi ya rangi ya dongo yenye kundu, na tembeze zichiochwa zina ladha dza njugu.

teaser.en: A sprawling seashore shrub whose glossy leaves lather like soap when rubbed in water.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha ufuoni kinachotambaa, ambacho majani yake yanayong'aa hutoa povu kama sabuni yakisuguliwa ndani ya maji.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha ufuwoni chinachotandazika, ambacho makodzage ganang'ala ganalavya povu dza sabuni ganaphosingbwa madzini.

teaser.en: A wild cucumber of the bush, its small spiny fruits looking edible but carrying a name that warns otherwise.
teaser.sw: Tango la porini la vichakani; matunda yake madogo yenye miiba yanaonekana kuliwa, lakini jina lake linaonya vinginevyo.
teaser.dg: Mtango wa weruni, ambao matundage madide genye miya ganaonekana dza ganafwaha kuriwa, ela dzinare rinaonya kukala sivyo.

teaser.en: A forest climber from a genus infamous for poisoning cattle.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa wa msituni kutoka jenasi inayojulikana vibaya kwa kuwatia ng'ombe sumu.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa tsakani wa kukpwera, wa jenasi inayomanyikana sana kpwa sumu inayolumiza ng'ombe.

teaser.en: Named after safari ants, though no one can quite say why.
teaser.sw: Umepewa jina la siafu, ingawa hakuna anayeweza kusema hasa kwa nini.
teaser.dg: Unaihwa kpwa dzina ra tsalafu, ela takuna mutu anayemanya hasa sababu.

teaser.en: A small coastal Grewia that shares its Digo name with a close cousin.
teaser.sw: Grewia ndogo ya pwani inayoshiriki jina lake la Kidigo na binamu yake wa karibu.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chidide cha Grewia cha pwani, ambacho chinahumira dzina mwenga ra Chidigo na nduguye wa phephi.

teaser.en: The second Mtsaye: a scrambling Grewia of the coastal thicket.
teaser.sw: Mtsaye wa pili: Grewia inayotambaa ya vichaka-mwitu vizito vya pwani.
teaser.dg: *Mtsaye* wa phiri: *Grewia* inayoambala ya vitsaka vya pwani.

teaser.en: The 'home digger': a creeping weed believed to dig out the peace of a homestead.
teaser.sw: 'Mchimbaji wa nyumbani': gugu linalotambaa linaloaminiwa kuchimbua amani ya boma.
teaser.dg: 'Anayetsimba kaya': mmea mdide unaoambala photsi, ambao atu anaamini unatsimba amani ya kaya.

teaser.en: Its thorns are the Digo tool for picking the kernel out of a marula nut.
teaser.sw: Miiba yake ndiyo chombo cha Wadigo cha kutolea kiini ndani ya kokwa la mng'ong'o.
teaser.dg: Adigo anahumira miyaye kutsokola chitsa kula ndani ya *ng’ongo*, tembe ngumu ya tunda ra *Mng’ongo*.

teaser.en: A hunter's name: its thorns were used to pick the brains out of a gazelle's skull.
teaser.sw: Jina la mwindaji: miiba yake ilitumika kuchokoa ubongo kutoka kwenye fuvu la swala.
teaser.dg: Dzina ra aindza: miyaye kala inahumirwa kutsokola *wongo* kula ndani ya zekeya ra chitswa cha swala.

teaser.en: 'Bloom in a new field': a tree believed to flower almost as soon as land is cleared.
teaser.sw: 'Chanua katika shamba jipya': mti unaoaminiwa kutoa maua karibu mara tu ardhi inapofyekwa.
teaser.dg: 'Tuluza maruwa munda muphya': muhi ambao atu anaamini unatuluza maruwa mara tu munda uchitemwa.

teaser.en: The only member of its genus: a glossy-leaved, sweet-scented shrub of the dry coastal country.
teaser.sw: Spishi pekee katika jenasi yake: kichaka chenye majani yanayong'aa na harufu tamu, cha maeneo makavu ya pwani.
teaser.dg: Ndiyo aina mwenga tu ya jenasiye: chitsaka cha tsi kavu ya pwani, chenye makodza ganang'ala na arufu nono.

teaser.en: Yellow flowers, then black fruits sitting on a bright red cushion like beads on a button.
teaser.sw: Maua ya manjano, kisha matunda meusi yaliyokaa juu ya mto mwekundu angavu kama shanga juu ya kifungo.
teaser.dg: Maruwa ga rangi ya mandano, na badaye matunda maru ganagokala dzulu ya nyama-nyama ya kundu inayong'ala, dza ushanga dzulu ya chifungo.

teaser.en: A forest liana whose bright red pods split open to show black seeds.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa wa msituni ambao maganda yake mekundu angavu hupasuka kuonyesha mbegu nyeusi.
teaser.dg: Mmea unaokpwera wa tsakani, wenye makakaya ga kundu ganagong'ala ganagoahuka kuonyesa tembe nyiru.

teaser.en: A wild relative of the passion fruit, from a genus best treated with caution.
teaser.sw: Jamaa wa porini wa pasheni, kutoka jenasi inayofaa kushughulikiwa kwa tahadhari.
teaser.dg: Ndugu wa weruni wa *mtunda*, wa jenasi ambayo mutu ni lazima adzirinde nayo.

teaser.en: Green above, silver below: the Digo know this Croton by the two colours of its leaves.
teaser.sw: Kijani juu, fedha chini: Wadigo huijua Croton hii kwa rangi mbili za majani yake.
teaser.dg: Chijani dzulu, rangi ya feza photsi: Adigo anaumanya *Croton* uhu kpwa rangi mbiri za makodzage.

teaser.en: The 'cattle herder': a small wild hibiscus of the grazing grounds.
teaser.sw: 'Mchungaji wa ng'ombe': hibiskasi ndogo ya porini ya malishoni.
teaser.dg: 'Mutu anayetsunga ng’ombe': *hibiscus* mdide wa weruni unaomera marisani.

teaser.en: Named after the hare, for reasons nobody can explain.
teaser.sw: Umepewa jina la sungura, kwa sababu ambazo hakuna anayeweza kuzieleza.
teaser.dg: Dzinare ni ra tsungula, ela takuna mutu anayeweza kueleza sababu.

teaser.en: A bitter-leaved bush with fluffy white flower heads, a close cousin of the famous bitter leaf.
teaser.sw: Kichaka chenye majani machungu na vichwa vya maua meupe laini kama pamba, binamu wa karibu wa *bitter leaf* maarufu.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha makodza ga utsungu chenye vitswa vya maruwa vyereru, laini dza pamba, ndugu wa phephi wa *bitter leaf* inayomanyikana sana.

teaser.en: To the Digo, the passion fruit vine is simply 'the fruit plant'.
teaser.sw: Kwa Wadigo, mkarakara ni 'mmea wa tunda' tu.
teaser.dg: Kpwa Adigo, mmea hinyu unaokpwera wa *passion fruit* ni 'mmea wa matunda' tu.

teaser.en: The forest's own jasmine: the wild cousin of the scented flowers women wear in their hair.
teaser.sw: Asmini ya msituni yenyewe: binamu wa porini wa maua yenye harufu nzuri ambayo wanawake huvaa nywele zao.
teaser.dg: Asmini ya tsakani: ndugu wa weruni wa maruwa ga arufu nono ganagovwalwa ni achetu nyereni.

teaser.en: The only plant the Digo identify by ear: listen for the wind whistling through its hollow thorns.
teaser.sw: Mmea pekee ambao Wadigo huutambua kwa sikio: sikiliza upepo ukipiga mluzi kupitia miiba yake yenye uwazi ndani.
teaser.dg: Mmea mwenga tu ambao Adigo anaumanya kpwa kusikira: sikira phepho richipiga milozi kahi ya miyaye mihuphu.

teaser.en: 'The forest banana': a rare, sweet-scented coastal tree whose fruits look like little bunches of bananas.
teaser.sw: 'Ndizi ya msituni': mti adimu wa pwani wenye harufu tamu, ambao matunda yake yanafanana na vichane vidogo vya ndizi.
teaser.dg: 'Izu ra tsakani': muhi adimu wa pwani wa arufu nono, ambao matundage ganahalana na mafungu madide ga mazu.

teaser.en: The forest double of a grassland shrub, though botanists put the two in different families.
teaser.sw: Pacha wa msituni wa kichaka cha nyikani, ingawa wataalamu wa mimea wamewaweka katika familia tofauti.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa tsakani unaohalana na chitsaka cha nyasini, ela asayansi a mimea anaika mimea iyo miiri kpwenye jamii mbiri tafwauti.

teaser.en: A fisherman's shrub: its sticks are used to catch koe, a small sea creature.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha wavuvi: vijiti vyake hutumika kuvua koe, kiumbe mdogo wa baharini.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha avuvi: vigongovye nkuhumirwa kuvuwa *koe*, nyama mdide wa bahari.

teaser.en: A fern that keeps the water in the bucket: its fronds float on top to stop it splashing on the carrier's head.
teaser.sw: Kivumbasi kinachotuliza maji ndooni: majani yake huelea juu ili maji yasimrukie mbebaji kichwani.
teaser.dg: *Fern* inayorinda madzi ndooni: makodzage nkuikpwa dzulu ya madzi ili gasimwagike dzulu ya chitswa cha mutu anayedzihika ndoo.

teaser.en: One of the world's most widespread plants, and one of its more poisonous ferns.
teaser.sw: Mmoja wa mimea iliyoenea zaidi duniani, na mojawapo ya vivumbasi vyenye sumu zaidi.
teaser.dg: Mwenga wa mimea inayomera phatu phanji zaidi duniani, na mwenga wa *fern* zenye sumu zaidi.

teaser.en: A fat-stemmed succulent with showy pink trumpets, and sap poisonous enough to tip an arrow.
teaser.sw: Mmea wenye shina nene, maua ya waridi yenye umbo la tarumbeta, na utomvu wenye sumu kali ya kutosha kupaka mshale.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha madzi-madzi chenye kolo ra kufutuka na maruwa manono ga pinki ga umbo ra ndzumari, na maziya ga sumu kali hata ganaweza kutiywa kpwenye ntsa za mivi.

teaser.en: A small twining bean of the bush, filed by the Digo among the 'female' climbers.
teaser.sw: Mmea mdogo wa jamii ya kunde unaojizungusha porini, ambao Wadigo huuweka miongoni mwa mimea inayotambaa ya 'kike'.
teaser.dg: Mmea mdide wa weruni wa jamii ya kunde unaodzilinga-linga, ambao Adigo anauika kahi ya mbugu za 'chichetu'.

teaser.en: A wild grape vine the Digo know by its stem rather than its leaves.
teaser.sw: Mzabibu pori ambao Wadigo huutambua kwa shina lake badala ya majani.
teaser.dg: Mzabibu wa weruni ambao Adigo anaumanya kpwa muhiwe, si kpwa makodzage.

teaser.en: A wild grape with five-fingered leaves, scrambling through the coastal bush.
teaser.sw: Mzabibu pori wenye majani ya vidole vitano, unaotambaa katikati ya vichaka vya pwani.
teaser.dg: Mzabibu wa weruni wenye makodza ga vyala tsano dza mkpwono, unaoambala kahi ya vitsaka vya pwani.
