teaser.en: Touch it once and you will never forget its name: its hairy leaves leave the skin itching.
teaser.sw: Ukiugusa mara moja hutalisahau jina lake kamwe: majani yake yenye manyoya huacha ngozi ikiwasha.
teaser.dg: Uchiuguta mara mwenga tu, kundariyala dzinare: makodzage genye nyere ganaawisa ngozi.

teaser.en: The 'female spirit-being': one of a family of aromatic-rooted shrubs named after the spirits they are used against.
teaser.sw: 'Kiumbe-roho wa kike': mmoja wa kundi la vichaka vyenye mizizi yenye harufu, vilivyopewa majina ya pepo ambao hutumika dhidi yao.
teaser.dg: 'Pepho wa chichetu': mmwenga wa kundi ra vitsaka vyenye mizi ya arufu nono, vinavyoihwa kpwa madzina ga pepho ambao vinahumirwa kuazuwiya.

teaser.en: A thorny-twigged terminalia with wood so tough it was used for the keels of dhows.
teaser.sw: Mwangati wenye vitawi vya miiba na mbao ngumu kiasi kwamba zilitumika kutengeneza mataruma ya majahazi.
teaser.dg: Muhi wa jenasi ya *Terminalia* wenye maphungo ga miya, na nyama za muhi huno ni nyifu sana hata kare zahumirwa kuhendera mikuku ya majahazi.

teaser.en: A wild hibiscus with vine-shaped leaves and yellow flowers with a dark heart.
teaser.sw: Hibiscus pori wenye majani ya umbo la majani ya mzabibu na maua ya manjano yenye kiini cheusi.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa *Hibiscus* wa weruni wenye makodza dza ga mzabibu, na maruwa ga rangi ya mandano genye kahi-kahi nyiru.

teaser.en: Turn a leaf over: green on top, pale beneath. That two-tone leaf is how the Digo pick out mweza.
teaser.sw: Geuza jani: juu ni kijani, chini ni jeupe-jeupe. Jani hilo la rangi mbili ndilo Wadigo hutumia kuutambua *mweza*.
teaser.dg: Penduza kodza: dzulu ni ra chijani, photsi ni ngushu-ngushu. Kodza hiri ra rangi mbiri ndiro Adigo anarihumira kumanya *mweza*.

teaser.en: A wild asparagus whose name boasts that its medicine could bring down a kingfish.
teaser.sw: Asparagasi pori ambao jina lake linajigamba kwamba dawa yake inaweza kumwangusha nguru.
teaser.dg: *Mwinika* wa weruni ambao dzinare rinadzivuna kukala muhasowe unaweza kugbwaga ngulu.

teaser.en: The seaside cousin of a poison shrub, at least in Digo eyes: a hairy coastal bush with white, woolly flowers.
teaser.sw: Binamu wa pwani wa kichaka chenye sumu, angalau machoni pa Wadigo: kichaka cha pwani chenye manyoya na maua meupe yenye sufu.
teaser.dg: Kpwa matso ga Adigo, ni nduguye wa pwani wa chitsaka cha sumu: chitsaka cha pwani chenye nyere, na maruwa mereru genye nyere nyinji.

teaser.en: A wild relative of the clove tree whose Digo name carries a feminine prefix.
teaser.sw: Ndugu pori wa mkarafuu ambao jina lake la Kidigo lina kiambishi cha kike.
teaser.dg: Muhi wa weruni wa jamii mwenga na karafuu, ambao dzinare ra Chidigo rinaandza na mwandzo wa 'chichetu'.

teaser.en: One Digo name, four different trees and shrubs. This is the Diphasia, a citrus-family tree known by its leaves.
teaser.sw: Jina moja la Kidigo, miti na vichaka vinne tofauti. Huu ni Diphasia, mti wa familia ya michungwa unaotambulika kwa majani yake.
teaser.dg: Dzina mwenga ra Chidigo, mihi na vitsaka vinne tafwauti. Uhu ni *Diphasia*, muhi wa jamii ya michungbwa unaomanyikana kpwa makodzage.

teaser.en: A rough-leaved bush with small sweet-scented flowers and orange berries, sharing its Digo name with three other plants.
teaser.sw: Kichaka chenye majani makwaruzu, maua madogo yenye harufu nzuri na matunda ya rangi ya chungwa, kinachoshiriki jina lake la Kidigo na mimea mingine mitatu.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chenye makodza ganayokaraza, maruwa madide ga arufu nono na matunda ga rangi ya chungbwa; dzinare ra Chidigo nkuhumirwa piya kpwa mimea yanjina mihahu.

teaser.en: A coastal Ehretia with clusters of small white flowers, one of four plants the Digo call nchikoma.
teaser.sw: Ehretia ya pwani yenye mafungu ya maua madogo meupe, mmoja wa mimea minne ambayo Wadigo huiita nchikoma.
teaser.dg: Ehretia ya pwani yenye mafungu ga maruwa madide mereru, na ni mmwenga wa mimea mine ambayo Adigo anaiiha nchikoma.

teaser.en: A citrus-family tree with single, Eugenia-like leaves, and one of four plants sharing the Digo name nchikoma.
teaser.sw: Mti wa familia ya michungwa wenye majani mamoja kama ya Eugenia, na mmoja wa mimea minne inayoshiriki jina la Kidigo nchikoma.
teaser.dg: Muhi wa jamii ya machungbwa wenye makodza ga kodza mwenga dza ga Eugenia, na ni mmwenga wa mimea mine yenye dzina ra Chidigo nchikoma.

teaser.en: The 'male' of the shade tree nchivuri: a smaller forest-floor cousin from the same family.
teaser.sw: 'Dume' wa mti wa kivuli nchivuri: binamu mdogo wa sakafu ya msitu, wa familia ileile.
teaser.dg: 'Mlume' wa *nchivuri*, muhi wa chivuri-vuri: ndugu mdide zaidi wa jamii mwenga, unaomera photsi kahi ya tsaka.

teaser.en: The 'male sedge': short spikelets make it the husband of the longer-flowered ndago chetu.
teaser.sw: 'Ndago dume': vishada vyake vifupi vya maua vinaufanya kuwa mume wa ndago chetu, wenye maua marefu zaidi.
teaser.dg: 'Ndago ya chilume': vitswavye vya maruwa ni vifupi, kpwa hivyo ni mlume wa ndago chetu, ambayo maruwage ni mare zaidi.

teaser.en: The farm sedge: a creeping weed with a little green-white pompom on each stem.
teaser.sw: Ndago wa shambani: gugu linalotambaa lenye kishungi kidogo cha kijani-cheupe juu ya kila shina.
teaser.dg: Ndago ya munda: mbondo inayoambala photsi, yenye chitswa chidide cha mviringo cha chijani na nyereru dzulu ya chila muhi.

teaser.en: Nutgrass, the weed farmers cannot kill: dig it up and its chains of little tubers sprout again.
teaser.sw: Ndago, gugu ambalo wakulima hawawezi kuliua: ukilichimbua, minyororo yake ya viazi vidogo huchipuka tena.
teaser.dg: Ndago ziya, mbondo ambayo akurima taaweza kuiolaga: uchiitsimba, minyororo ya viazivye vidide inamera tsona.

teaser.en: Its seeds twist into tangles and drill into socks and skin; its stems thatch Digo houses.
teaser.sw: Mbegu zake hujisokota kuwa mafundo na kutoboa soksi na ngozi; mashina yake huezeka nyumba za Wadigo.
teaser.dg: Tembeze zinadzisokota na kutsanganyikana, na zinainjira ndani ya soksi na ngozi; mihiye nkuhumirwa kuezeka nyumba za Adigo.

teaser.en: A forked-thorn bush seen as the wild, outdoor twin of a spirit medicine bought in Indian shops.
teaser.sw: Kichaka chenye miiba yenye panda kinachochukuliwa kuwa pacha wa porini wa dawa ya pepo inayonunuliwa madukani mwa Wahindi.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chenye miya ya panda, chinachoonwa dza patsa wa weruni wa dawa ya pepho inayogulwa madukani ga Ahindi.

teaser.en: Named for the way it spreads over the ground like a roof.
teaser.sw: Umepewa jina kutokana na jinsi unavyotandaa juu ya ardhi kama paa.
teaser.dg: Chikaihwa vivyo kpwa sababu chinaenea dzulu ya tsi dza makuti ganavyofwinika nyumba.

teaser.en: Its name simply means 'heal': a woolly, scrambling herb used against spirit-caused illness.
teaser.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'ponya' tu: mmea wenye sufu unaotambaa, unaotumika dhidi ya maradhi yanayosababishwa na pepo.
teaser.dg: Dzinare manage ni 'kuphoza' tu: mmea unaoambala, wenye nyere nyereru dza sufi, unaohumirwa kuphoza makongo ganayorehwa ni pepho.

teaser.en: A strong-smelling roadside mint named after the spirit it is used against.
teaser.sw: Mmea wa jamii ya mnanaa wenye harufu kali unaoota kando ya barabara, uliopewa jina la pepo unaotumika dhidi yake.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa jamii ya *mint* wenye arufu kali, unaomera kanda-kanda ya njira, na unaihwa kpwa dzina ra pepho ambaye nkuhumirwa kumzuwiya.

teaser.en: A fleshy-leaved scrambler whose name means 'neutralizer': it is used to undo witchcraft.
teaser.sw: Mmea unaotambaa wenye majani manene ambao jina lake lina maana ya 'kiondoa nguvu': hutumika kutangua uchawi.
teaser.dg: Mmea unaoambala wenye makodza ganayonona, ambao dzinare manage ni 'chitu cha kureza': nkuhumirwa kuusa utsai.

teaser.en: The little black needles that cling to your trousers after a walk through any field.
teaser.sw: Vile vijiti vidogo vyeusi vinavyonasa kwenye suruali yako baada ya kutembea katika shamba lolote.
teaser.dg: Tembe ndide nyiru dza sindano, zinazogbwira suruwaleyo uchinyendeka kahi ya munda wowosi.

teaser.en: A floating pond plant with fringed yellow flowers, whose blooms are used in spiritual healing.
teaser.sw: Mmea wa bwawani unaoelea, wenye maua ya manjano yenye pindo, ambayo hutumika katika uponyaji wa kiroho.
teaser.dg: Mmea unaoelea dzulu ya madzi ga ziya, wenye maruwa ga rangi ya mandano genye mapindo, na maruwa higo nkuhumirwa kpwa uganga wa pepho.

teaser.en: A true water lily, called 'small toro', whose flowers are used in spiritual healing.
teaser.sw: Yungiyungi halisi, linaloitwa 'toro ndogo', ambalo maua yake hutumika katika uponyaji wa kiroho.
teaser.dg: *Water lily* ya kpweli, inayoihwa '*toro* ndide', ambayo maruwaye nkuhumirwa kpwa uganga wa pepho.

teaser.en: The incense of the sea side: a coastal Vitex whose fragrant gum is burned like ubani.
teaser.sw: Ubani wa ufukweni: *Vitex* wa pwani ambaye utomvu wake wenye harufu nzuri huchomwa kama ubani.
teaser.dg: 'Ubani wa pwani': *Vitex* ya pwani ambayo gamuye yenye arufu nono nkufukizwa dza ubani.

teaser.en: So new to Digo farms that it never got a name of its own: it is simply 'tubers'.
teaser.sw: Ni zao geni mno katika mashamba ya Wadigo kiasi kwamba halikupata jina lake lenyewe: huitwa tu 'viazi'.
teaser.dg: Ni viphya sana kpwenye minda ya Adigo hata taviphaha dzina ravyo: vinaihwa tu 'viazi'.

teaser.en: The 'wild vwivwi': a yam whose name itself is a warning not to eat it.
teaser.sw: 'Vwivwi wa porini': kiazi kikuu ambacho jina lake lenyewe ni onyo kwamba kisiliwe.
teaser.dg: '*Vwivwi* ya weruni': *yam* ambayo dzinare renye ni onyo kukala taifwaha kuriwa.

teaser.en: A silvery wild bean that sprawls across the ground just like a sweet-potato vine.
teaser.sw: Kunde-pori wa rangi ya fedha anayetambaa ardhini kama mtambaa wa kiazi kitamu.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa weruni wa jamii ya kunde, wa rangi ya feza, unaoambala photsi dza vira muyogbwe unavyoambala.

teaser.en: The pale nimakoba: one of a pair of brittle woodland mushrooms told apart by the colour of their caps.
teaser.sw: Nimakoba mweupe: mmoja wa jozi ya uyoga wa msituni unaovunjika kwa urahisi, inayotofautishwa kwa rangi ya kofia zake.
teaser.dg: *Nimakoba* mwereru: aina mwenga kahi ya aina mbiri za uoga wa matsakani unaovundzika rahisi, zinazotafwautishwa kpwa rangi ya kofiya zao.

teaser.en: The red nimakoba: a bright-capped brittlegill that Digo women collect in the rains.
teaser.sw: Nimakoba mwekundu: uyoga wa jenasi *Russula* wenye kofia ya rangi angavu ambao wanawake wa Kidigo huukusanya wakati wa mvua.
teaser.dg: *Nimakoba* wa kundu: *Russula* yenye kofiya ya kundu inayong'ala, ambayo achetu a Chidigo anaitsola wakati wa mvula.

teaser.en: A red-capped brittlegill with a name that, word for word, seems to compare it to a baboon's backside.
teaser.sw: Uyoga wa jenasi *Russula* wenye kofia nyekundu, ambao jina lake, neno kwa neno, linaonekana kuulinganisha na tako la nyani.
teaser.dg: *Russula* yenye kofiya ya kundu, ambayo dzinare, neno kpwa neno, rinaonekana kuiringanisha na hako ra nyani.

teaser.en: Mushrooms farmed by termites: nkuvi push up from the nest after rain, and the Digo know at least three kinds.
teaser.sw: Uyoga unaolimwa na mchwa: nkuvi huchipuka kutoka kwenye kichuguu baada ya mvua, na Wadigo wanajua angalau aina tatu.
teaser.dg: *Uoga* unaorimwa ni malutswa: nkuvi zinatuluka kula nyumba za malutswa bada ya mvula, na Adigo anamanya aina tahu au zaidi.

teaser.en: The 'meat mushroom', said to be as tasty as beef.
teaser.sw: 'Uyoga wa nyama', unaosemekana kuwa mtamu kama nyama ya ng'ombe.
teaser.dg: 'Uoga wa nyama', ambao nkugombwa kukala una mtswano dza nyama ya ng'ombe.

teaser.en: Break it and it bleeds milk: the Digo group this mushroom with milky plants like asthma weed.
teaser.sw: Uvunje na unatoa maziwa: Wadigo huuweka uyoga huu pamoja na mimea yenye maziwa kama mziwaziwa.
teaser.dg: Uchiuvundza unalavya maziya: Adigo anauika uoga huno fungu mwenga na mimea yenye maziya dza *chiziyaziya*.

teaser.en: Squeeze a ripe one and it puffs out brown dust: to the Digo, a hyena's tobacco.
teaser.sw: Ukiubana ulioiva hutoa vumbi la kahawia: kwa Wadigo, ni tumbaku ya fisi.
teaser.dg: Uchiminya iriyoivwa, inalavya vumbi ra rangi ya dongo: kpwa Adigo, ni tumbaku ya fisi.

teaser.en: The hard, shelf-like fungus on old tree trunks, named by the Digo but not counted as a mushroom.
teaser.sw: Kuvu ngumu yenye umbo la rafu kwenye vigogo vya miti mizee, iliyopewa jina na Wadigo lakini isiyohesabiwa kuwa uyoga.
teaser.dg: Chitu chigumu dza chibao chinachotuluka kpwenye makolo ga mihi ya kare; Adigo anachiiha dzina, ela taachitala kukala ni uoga.

teaser.en: A named but still unidentified Digo mushroom, one of several whose names carry a 'female' prefix.
teaser.sw: Uyoga wa Kidigo wenye jina lakini bado haujatambuliwa, mmoja wa kadhaa ambao majina yao yana kiambishi cha 'kike'.
teaser.dg: Uoga wa Chidigo wenye dzina, ela ambao bado taudzangbwemanyikana kpwa chisayansi; ni mwenga wa uoga kadhaa ambao madzinage ganaandza na mwandzo wenye mana ya chichetu.

teaser.en: A Digo mushroom with a name but, so far, no scientific identity.
teaser.sw: Uyoga wa Kidigo wenye jina lakini, hadi sasa, bila utambulisho wa kisayansi.
teaser.dg: Uoga wa Chidigo wenye dzina, ela ambao hata sambi taudzangbwemanyikana kpwa chisayansi.

teaser.en: An unidentified Digo mushroom whose name echoes the word for a rooster.
teaser.sw: Uyoga wa Kidigo ambao haujatambuliwa, wenye jina linalokumbusha neno la jogoo.
teaser.dg: Uoga wa Chidigo ambao taudzangbwemanyikana kpwa chisayansi, na dzinare rinahalana na *dzogolo*, kuku mlume.

teaser.en: An unidentified mushroom whose name recalls the chameleon.
teaser.sw: Uyoga ambao haujatambuliwa, wenye jina linalomkumbusha mtu kinyonga.
teaser.dg: Uoga ambao taudzangbwemanyikana kpwa chisayansi, na dzinare rinatambukiza *lumbwi*.

teaser.en: A Digo mushroom still waiting for a scientific name.
teaser.sw: Uyoga wa Kidigo ambao bado unasubiri jina la kisayansi.
teaser.dg: Uoga wa Chidigo ambao bado unagodzera dzina ra chisayansi.

teaser.en: An unidentified mushroom whose name shares a root with the Digo word for something slippery.
teaser.sw: Uyoga ambao haujatambuliwa, wenye jina linaloshiriki mzizi na neno la Kidigo la kitu kinachoteleza.
teaser.dg: Uoga ambao taudzangbwemanyikana kpwa chisayansi, na dzinare rina asili mwenga na neno ra Chidigo ra chitu chenye uhereza.

teaser.en: A Digo mushroom with a lively, repeating name and, as yet, no scientific identity.
teaser.sw: Uyoga wa Kidigo wenye jina changamfu linalojirudia na, hadi sasa, bila utambulisho wa kisayansi.
teaser.dg: Uoga wa Chidigo wenye dzina ra mtswano, ra seemu mbiri zinazohalana, na ambao bado taudzangbwemanyikana kpwa chisayansi.

teaser.en: An unidentified 'nima-' mushroom whose name may point to a leg of meat.
teaser.sw: Uyoga wa 'nima-' ambao haujatambuliwa, ambao jina lake huenda linaashiria paja la nyama.
teaser.dg: Uoga wa *nima-* ambao taudzangbwemanyikana kpwa chisayansi, na dzinare chahi rinahusu rondo ra nyama.
